title: Bookkeeper (E-commerce)
description:
About Us:

We are a US C-Corp operating a global direct-to-consumer e-commerce business selling into the United States, Canada, the UK, and Australia. We sell across multiple platforms and currencies and work with international contractors and vendors.

You do not need to be US-based, but you must have strong experience with US bookkeeping requirements for a US C-Corp and be comfortable supporting tax preparation in coordination with external CPAs.





What You’ll Be Responsible For:

- Full-cycle bookkeeping for a US C-Corp

- Accurate daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow)

- Cash flow tracking and basic forecasting support

- COGS, inventory, accruals, and e-commerce-specific bookkeeping

- Multi-currency reconciliation and FX awareness

- Payroll processing for contractors and international vendors (weekly)

- Preparation and support for US tax filings (corporate, sales tax, information returns)

- Ongoing coordination with CPAs and tax advisors as needed





Platforms & Tools (Experience Required):

- Quickbooks (primary accounting platform)

- A2X (Shopify & Amazon integrations)

- Shopify

- PayPal

- Airwallex (banking, vendor payments, payroll)

- Meta Ads (ad spend reconciliation & financial reporting awareness)



International E-commerce Experience:

- Strong understanding of US sales tax nexus and compliance coordination

- Familiarity with VAT / GST considerations (UK, AU, CA)

- Experience working with international contractors (W-8s, W-9s, 1099s)

- Understanding of cross-border payments, FX fees, and settlement timing

- Solid grasp of e-commerce revenue recognition



Ideal Background:

- Professional Bookkeeper with e-commerce specialization

- Proven experience supporting US C-Corps

- Experience with 7-figure+ DTC brands preferred

- Highly detail-oriented, proactive, and founder-friendly

- Able to clearly explain financials and flag issues early



Engagement:

- Ongoing, long-term role

- Flexible hours, but strict reporting cadence is essential



Please include in Your Application:

- Relevant e-commerce experience

- Tools you’ve worked with (Quickbooks, A2X, Shopify, Amazon, Airwallex, etc.)

- Your experience with US C-Corp accounting and tax support

- Any payroll experience (contractors, international vendors)



We’re looking for a long-term finance partner, not just data entry.

title: Paid Media Specialist – Meta & Google Ads | E-commerce / Shopify
description:
Full-time | Remote | $320 USD/week



Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm CET/CEST

Philippine hours: Approx. 3:00pm–11:00pm or 4:00pm–12:00am depending on European daylight saving



The Role



We’re hiring an experienced hands-on Paid Media Specialist to manage Meta Ads and Google Ads for an established European fashion/e-commerce business operating across Sweden, Norway and the Netherlands.



This is not a social media management or agency-coordination role.



You will personally manage and optimize live advertising accounts, control budgets, analyze Shopify revenue and make daily decisions to improve profitable growth.



Creative assets will be supplied by the marketing team, allowing you to focus on media buying, testing, optimization, tracking and commercial performance.



What You'll Own

- Build, launch and optimize Meta Ads and Google Ads

- Manage campaigns across Sweden, Norway and the Netherlands

- Control and pace daily advertising budgets

- Manage Google Shopping, Performance Max and Search campaigns

- Manage Meta prospecting, retargeting and catalogue campaigns

- Run structured tests across audiences, bidding, offers, products, creatives and landing pages

- Analyze ROAS, MER, CAC/CPA, CVR, AOV, revenue and spend

- Use Shopify performance, inventory and promotions to guide advertising decisions

- Monitor and troubleshoot conversion tracking

- Maintain daily e-commerce performance/P&L reporting

- Give concise daily updates on results, risks and actions

- Help transition paid media management from an external agency to the internal team



You Must Have



Please apply only if you meet ALL of the following:

- 3+ years of hands-on paid media/performance marketing experience in e-commerce or DTC

- Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager

- Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads

- Experience personally building, testing and optimizing live campaigns

- Working knowledge of Shopify

- Strong Excel/Google Sheets and performance-reporting skills

- Working knowledge of GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, CAPI, UTMs and attribution

- Ability to analyze performance and make commercially sound budget decisions

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Reliable availability for the full 9:00am–5:00pm CET/CEST working day

- Comfortable with compensation of $320 USD per week



Please do not apply if your experience is mainly organic social media, content creation, SEO, general VA work, or coordinating an agency rather than personally managing paid campaigns.



Big Advantage If You Have

- Paid media experience in Sweden, Norway, the Netherlands or other European markets

- Fashion, apparel, footwear or consumer-brand experience

- Google Shopping / Performance Max / Merchant Center experience

- Meta catalogue / Advantage+ experience

- Klaviyo or
/SMS lifecycle marketing experience

- Experience bringing paid media management in-house



How to Apply

Please answer all 6 questions below. Applications without specific answers may not be considered.



1. How many years have you personally managed BOTH Meta Ads and Google Ads for e-commerce/DTC brands?



2. Tell us about your strongest e-commerce campaign.

Include:



Product/category

Country/market

Monthly spend

ROAS or MER

CPA/CAC

What you personally changed to achieve the result



3. What is the largest monthly advertising budget you have personally controlled?



4. Rate your hands-on ability from 1–5 for each:



Meta Ads: __/5

Google Ads: __/5

Google Shopping/PMax: __/5

Shopify: __/5

GA4: __/5

GTM: __/5

Meta Pixel/CAPI: __/5

Excel/Google Sheets: __/5



5. Have you managed paid advertising in Europe? If yes, which countries?



6. Confirm both:



I can consistently work Monday–Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm CET/CEST: YES / NO

I accept compensation of $320 USD per week: YES / NO



Please you must attach your latest CV and, if available, screenshots or case studies showing campaigns you personally managed.



We are looking for someone who can own the accounts, understand the numbers and make smart commercial decisions every day.

title: Interior Designer
description:
Interior Designer – Residential Design Collections



Remote | 3-6-Month Contract | TSC Supply



TSC Supply is looking for a creative and experienced **Interior Designer** to join us on an initial 3-month contract to help develop our new residential **Selection Studio & Design Collections**.



This is a creative project focused on developing a range of complete interior concepts that showcase our joinery, materials, hardware accessories and building products.



## The Role



You will work with our team to develop approximately **12 coordinated interior design collections**, ranging from high-end luxury residential through to contemporary homes, apartments, townhouses and developer projects.



Each collection will have its own design style, colour palette and material selections using actual products, finishes and hardware supplied by TSC Supply.



The work will include concepts for:



* Kitchens & butler's pantries

* Wardrobes & walk-in wardrobes

* Bathroom vanities & powder rooms

* Laundries

* TV & living room cabinetry

* Home office / study joinery

* Material and colour palettes

* Internal cabinetry storage and hardware solutions



## Joinery Hardware & Accessories



An important part of the project will be showing the different functional hardware and storage accessories available within our joinery.



This may include:



* Pantry pull-out systems

* Tall pantry units

* Corner storage systems / magic corners

* Pull-out baskets

* Drop-down overhead shelving

* Internal drawers

* Cutlery and utensil organisers

* Bin and waste systems

* Under-sink storage

* Spice and bottle pull-outs

* Appliance storage

* Lift-up door systems

* Soft-close hinges and drawer systems

* Wardrobe pull-down hanging rails

* Trouser racks

* Shoe storage

* Jewellery and accessory drawers

* Wardrobe organisers

* LED-integrated shelving

* Other smart kitchen and wardrobe storage solutions



These should be incorporated into the designs where appropriate and also presented clearly within the final Selection Studio so clients can understand the available options and upgrades.



## Key Responsibilities



* Develop creative interior concepts and mood boards

* Create coordinated colour and material palettes

* Design residential joinery concepts

* Work with our supplied melamine, stone, tile, tapware and hardware selections

* Incorporate functional storage and joinery accessories into designs

* Produce high-quality, photorealistic 3D renders

* Develop different design levels from **premium/luxury through to developer/investor**

* Create material boards and finish schedules

* Create hardware and accessory selection pages

* Work with our team to refine concepts and designs

* Assist in presenting the final collections in a premium, architectural style



## What We're Looking For



* Qualified or experienced Interior Designer

* Strong residential interior design portfolio

* Excellent design and colour coordination skills

* Strong kitchen and joinery design experience

* Good understanding of cabinetry hardware and internal storage solutions

* Experience producing photorealistic renders

* Good understanding of materials, finishes and detailing

* Able to work independently from a creative brief

* Strong attention to detail

* Good English communication



Experience working on **Australian residential projects** would be highly regarded.



## Software



Experience with some of the following is preferred:



* SketchUp

* Enscape

* Lumion

* D5 Render

* 3ds Max

* Corona / V-Ray

* AutoCAD

* Adobe Creative Suite



We are more interested in the **quality of your design work, creativity and renders** than the specific software you use.



## Contract



**Initial Term:** 3 months

**Location:** Remote

**Type:** Contract / Project Based



There may be an opportunity for ongoing work following the initial project.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your interior design portfolio

3. Examples of kitchens, bathrooms, wardrobes and residential interiors you have designed

4. Examples of your 3D rendering work

5. Any examples showing kitchen or wardrobe storage solutions

6. Software you use

7. Your expected monthly rate

8. Your availability to start



**Important:** Please only apply if you can provide a portfolio demonstrating your own interior design and rendering work.

description:
About Dreambound



Dreambound helps people in the US find and enroll in career training programs, from healthcare to trades to tech.
 is one of our revenue channels, and we're investing in taking it to the next level.



About the Role



We're looking for a senior

This is a hands-on expert role. You'll be trusted with real revenue responsibility: our goal is to grow
 revenue roughly 10% month over month while keeping our sender reputation healthy. You should be the kind of person who spots a deliverability dip before anyone else does and already has a fix in motion. You will work closely with our EM team that will help you execute your strategies.



What You'll Do



*Lifecycle campaigns

     - Build, QA, and run automated campaigns around the lead journey (form funnel follow-ups, application nudges, re-engagement, rejection flows)

     - Verify enrollments, segments, and trigger events are firing correctly, and catch silent exclusions before they cost revenue

     - Build tracking links from scratch in Everflow with correct parameters so every click and conversion attributes accurately



*Testing and optimization

     - Keep at least one A/B test live on every active campaign, one element at a time, resolved cleanly

     - Match the metric to the test: subject lines to open rate, CTAs to click rate, everything ultimately to revenue

     - Use daily broadcasts as your idea lab, then promote winners into campaigns



*Deliverability and metrics

     - Own deliverability: Google Postmaster Tools, 
 deliverability tab, list hygiene, engagement filters, sunset policies

     - Hold our target thresholds on every send (delivered above 98%, open above 25%, click above 2%, unsub below 0.2%, hard bounce below 0.5%, spam below 0.08%)



*Communication

     - Flag issues early with a proposed solution, confirm task understanding in your own words, follow through same-day

     - Study competitor
 programs and bring the strongest ideas back



What We're Looking For



*Must-haves

     - 4+ years in lifecycle/email marketing with direct revenue accountability, ideally in lead generation, affiliate, edtech, or another performance-driven vertical

     - Expert-level experience in 
 (or deep experience in Iterable, Braze, or Klaviyo with proven ability to switch): segments, event-triggered journeys, Liquid personalization, conversion goals, webhooks

     - Proven deliverability recovery experience: you can walk us through a time you took a domain from Medium/Low reputation back to healthy, and explain the levers you pulled (volume throttling, engaged-only sending, list pruning, warm-up)

     - Fluent in
 authentication and infrastructure: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, one-click unsubscribe, and the current Gmail/Yahoo bulk sender requirements

     - Strong list hygiene instincts: sunset policies, engagement tiering, re-permission campaigns, suppression management, bounce classification (hard vs soft, and what to do with each)

     - Disciplined experimenter: single-variable A/B tests, correct metric per test, statistical patience, clean resolution, documented learnings

     - Sharp direct-response copywriting: subject lines, preview text, CTAs that get clicked by a US consumer audience

     - Data fluency: you can pull your own numbers, separate machine opens from human opens, calculate revenue per send/click, and spot when a metric shift is a tracking bug vs a real change

title: Customer Service/Receptionist - Australian Criminal Law Firm
description:
Customer Service/Receptionist - Australian Criminal Law Firm



We are a criminal law firm based in Australia, previously working with external call centres, but now building our dedicated in-house remote team. We currently have 4 valued team members based in the Philippines and are looking to add more members for long-term positions.



Position Overview



This is a home-based, full-time role with the potential to earn up to PHP 90,000/month, starting at PHP 50,000 during training period, which increases to PHP 80,000 post-training inclusive of the after-hours schedule, and bonuses up to PHP 10,000 in commissions.



Schedule & Hours



Permanent shifts:

 

*Sunday to Thursday (Friday and Saturday off)

*Tuesday to Saturday (Sunday and Monday off)



Regular shift



*8-hour shift, including a 45-minute lunch break

*7:00 AM–3:00 PM Manila Time

*During Australian Daylight Saving Time (DST): 6:00 AM–2:00 PM Manila Time

*This schedule aligns with Australian business hours.



Training period 



*Monday–Friday schedule

*Weekends off

*Once training is completed, you will transition to your permanent schedule, which will include a weekend(either Saturday or Sunday) and after-hours work.



After-hours coverage



After-hours work is shared between team members, with each person covering a 3.5-hour period.



Regular Time



*Team Member 1: 3:00 PM–6:30 PM

*Team Member 2: 6:30 PM–10:00 PM





During DST



*Team Member 1: 2:00 PM–5:30 PM

*Team Member 2: 5:30 PM–9:00 PM



Your specific permanent schedule and after-hours allocation will be assigned based on the team’s coverage requirements.



Your Duties Will Include:



*Learning the basics of criminal law in Australia

*Answering incoming calls and handling client inquiries professionally

*Gathering necessary information from incoming calls

*Accuracy in data entry, to book appointments in our database and calendar

*Handling frontline calls and transferring calls

*Managing live chat inquiries

*Collecting/Processing Payments (during after-hrs only)

*Assisting with after-hours and weekend nightphones





What We're Looking For:



*With experience in customer service and/or in sales (both is preferable)

*Fluent in English both verbal and written communication skills

*Excellent attention to detail

*Reliable computer and connection and with back up is mandatory, high-speed internet, second monitor, and quality *headphones and microphone (wireless is preferred)

*A quiet work environment is a MUST

*Availability for full-time work only — no side jobs or agency representation

*A team player, susceptible to feedback and able to adapt to a team setting

*Willing to work on Philippine holidays (with holiday pay already factored in)

*Open to permanently have a work schedule inclusive of a weekend (Either Saturday or Sunday)

*The ability to multitask to some extent



Why Join Us?



*Work closely with a team of 35+ Australian lawyers and staff

*Join a growing and stable firm that values its remote team

*Receive thorough training and continuous support

*Enjoy long-term stability — our current PH team has been with us for 3+ years

*We pay the 13th month and offer performance-based bonuses



How to Apply:



Please submit a voice and video introduction (e.g., via Vocaroo) explaining the following:



*A short introduction about yourself

*Your relevant work experience and skill set

*Why you think you’d be a great fit for this role



We will also need copies of the following:



*Your updated resume

*Typing test (to check speed and accuracy)



Kindly note that only applicants who submit a voice or video introduction will be considered.



Applications will be through via the online jobs platform only, any external applications will be disregarded





Do NOT apply if:



*You’re an agency

You plan to take on another job

description:
Athena Eye Care is a premium ophthalmology practice in Mission Viejo, California, specializing in refractive cataract surgery and lens replacement surgery. I am Dr. Audrey Tai, the owner and surgeon. I am hiring a full-time Virtual Medical Assistant to join my remote team of three VMAs, all based in the Philippines, who handle phones, scheduling, billing, and my surgical pipeline.

This is not a task job. It is a career position on a growing team. My current VMAs started with phones and administrative work, and through training have expanded into new skill sets, including marketing and social media skills they have learned since joining the practice. I am looking for someone who wants the same path: to build a long-term career here, expand their skills year over year, and become a permanent part of this team. If you have the ability and the desire to grow, I will train you and give you the opportunity.



Your starting responsibilities:



Incoming patient calls: answering the practice phone line professionally and warmly, taking messages, and routing patient questions correctly

Outbound patient calls: calling patients to schedule their six-month and annual follow-up appointments, appointment reminders, and rescheduling patients who missed their visits

Simple data entry in our EHR (DrChrono): uploading documents, entering explanation of benefits, moving appointments, and keeping records organized

Supporting the team with call overflow during busy clinic hours



What you will grow into, with training:



Appointment and laser procedure authorizations with insurance

Post-operative note processing for surgical patients

Simple billing data entry

Expanded responsibilities beyond these as your skills and the practice grow



Requirements:



Excellent spoken and written English. You will speak with elderly American patients by phone daily, so a clear, warm, patient phone manner is essential

Strong organizational skills. You will manage a daily call list and task queue and are expected to keep it current without being chased

Preference will be given to applicants with a medical background: experience in a medical practice, clinic, hospital, or healthcare account (BPO healthcare accounts count)

Prior HIPAA training is highly valued. You must have knowledge of, and willingness to follow, HIPAA compliance strictly (we will also train you and require a signed confidentiality agreement)

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, a good headset, and a backup power/internet plan

Available full time during US Pacific business hours



About working with me: I train thoroughly, document our procedures step by step, and give you direct feedback in your first month so expectations are clear. You will work inside a well-organized system. I value every team member highly, and bringing a new team member on board is an investment I make and value: I invest my time in your training, and I am looking for someone who will invest in return by growing with this practice for years. As your experience and responsibilities expand, we will talk.



How to apply

To apply, please send:



Your updated resume

A short voice recording (2-3 minutes) introducing yourself and describing your experience with patient or customer phone calls. This is required; applications without a voice recording will not be considered

One paragraph on your experience with medical or healthcare work, if any. Any certification of HIPAA training or EHR training from prior work experience is highly encouraged; please mention it in your answer

Your expected hourly rate and your internet speed test result (speedtest.net screenshot)



Working Hours

Full time, 40 hours/week, during US Pacific Time business hours (approximately 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PT, Monday to Friday). You must be available and reliable during this window.

English (speaking and writing), Customer Service, Phone Support, Data Entry, Medical Services, Admin Assistant, Scheduling

title: Manager Support Assistant
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and reliable Manager Support Assistant who can provide day-to-day operational and administrative support to a manager.



This role is ideal for someone who can work independently, identify what needs to be done without waiting for constant instructions, manage priorities effectively, and make sure tasks, files, follow-ups, and administrative activities are completed accurately and on time.



The successful candidate should be someone the manager can rely on to keep things organized, follow through on responsibilities, identify potential issues, and help keep daily operations moving smoothly.



This is not primarily an
-management or personal-assistant role. The focus is on operational support, organization, coordination, task management, documentation, follow-ups, and helping the manager stay focused on higher-priority responsibilities.



Key Responsibilities

Provide daily administrative and operational support to the manager.

Create, maintain, and organize Excel files, trackers, databases, and operational documents.

Ensure information, records, formulas, formats, and other file requirements are kept accurate and up to date.

Monitor pending tasks, deadlines, follow-ups, and outstanding items.

Proactively follow up with departments when information or action is required.

Coordinate with Admin, Sales, Operations, and other departments when necessary.

Conduct initial and final interviews and assist with recruitment-related activities.

Prepare interview schedules and coordinate with applicants and team members.

Help monitor team activities, updates, and outstanding requirements.

Troubleshoot basic administrative and communication issues independently.

Research and verify information before escalating questions to the manager.

Prepare summaries, reports, trackers, and updates when required.

Follow established processes, formats, and systems consistently.

Maintain confidentiality when handling company information.

Take initiative and identify additional tasks that need attention.

Handle ad hoc administrative and operational tasks assigned by the manager.

Assist with urgent or unexpected tasks that may arise during daily operations.

Quickly assess and prioritize ad hoc requests based on urgency and business impact.

Support special projects, process improvements, and other responsibilities as needed.

Support the manager in keeping daily operations organized and on track.



What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

Highly organized and detail-oriented.

Proactive rather than waiting for instructions.

Excellent at time management and prioritization.

A strong problem solver who looks for solutions before escalating an issue.

Reliable and consistent with follow-through.

Comfortable managing multiple tasks and deadlines.

Strong in written and verbal communication.

Comfortable working with Excel, Google Workspace, and other digital tools.

Able to maintain accurate records and follow established file formats.

Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

Comfortable coordinating with different departments and team members.

Confident conducting interviews and communicating with applicants.

Quick to learn new systems and processes.

Comfortable asking questions when clarification is genuinely needed, but also capable of researching and checking available information independently first.

Accountable for assigned responsibilities.

Flexible and able to handle ad hoc tasks and changing priorities.

Able to recognize what is urgent, what is important, and what can wait.



Important Expectations

This position requires a high level of ownership and accountability.

You will be expected to:

Complete tasks without constant reminders.

Keep files and trackers updated consistently.

Follow established formats, formulas, and processes.

Double-check your work before submitting it.

Follow up on outstanding tasks.

Communicate proactively when something is delayed or blocked.

Raise important issues early.

Take responsibility for mistakes and correct them promptly.

Manage your time effectively.

Adapt when priorities change.

Handle ad hoc requests efficiently.

Protect the manager's time by handling appropriate tasks independently.

We value initiative over constant supervision.



Qualifications

Previous experience as an Administrative Assistant, Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, Manager Assistant, Project Coordinator, or similar role is preferred.

Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

Strong organizational and documentation skills.

Experience coordinating schedules, interviews, or team activities is an advantage.

Experience working with multiple departments is an advantage.

Strong communication and follow-up skills.

Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Stable internet connection and reliable computer/laptop.

Strong attention to detail.

Ability to adapt to changing priorities and handle ad hoc responsibilities.



Application Requirements

Please submit your application to: 

Please include:

Updated resume/CV

Brief introduction

Current laptop/computer specifications

Internet speed

Backup internet connection

Backup power source

A short audio or video introduction highlighting your communication skills and experience.

Confirmation that you are available to work the required 3:00 PM – 3:00 AM (Vancouver Time) schedule



Previous experience supporting managers or handling administrative/operational responsibilities. We are looking for someone who can become a reliable operational support partner to the manager, not someone who needs to be reminded about every task.



If you are proactive, organized, accountable, detail-oriented, adaptable, and naturally look for ways to make things more efficient, we would love to hear from you.

title: Arkero Growth Partner | sales end to end
description:
Growth Partner – Australia NZ| Remote | Commission-Based



Arkero is building a new era of staffing.



We connect Australian and New Zealand businesses with skilled professionals in the Philippines, supported by technology designed to make the entire staffing process faster, simpler and easier for the client.



Our goal is simple: make staffing easier to sell, easier to buy and dramatically faster to deliver.



As we prepare to launch, we are expanding our network of Growth Partners across Australia.



This opportunity is for people who are confident in their ability to build relationships, generate business and close clients.



A System Designed to Be Simple to Sell



We have deliberately built Arkero to remove as much friction as possible from the staffing decision.



There are no placement fees and no upfront recruitment fees.



The client is not being asked to spend thousands of dollars before a staff member even starts.

That means Growth Partners can stay focused on what they do best: starting conversations, building relationships, closing business and generating placements.

Traditional staffing can be slow, expensive and heavily dependent on manual recruitment.



Clients can face large upfront recruitment fees and then still wait weeks for a suitable candidate.



Arkero is being built differently.



No placement fees. No upfront recruitment fees. Less friction. Faster decisions.



Our platform is designed to use technology and AI to help identify suitable talent, streamline workflows and dramatically reduce the time it takes to make a placement.



Our long-term goal is to move from the traditional model of waiting weeks for a candidate to making suitable placements possible in minutes.



That gives Growth Partners a very different proposition to take to market.



You are not asking a business to pay a large fee just to begin the recruitment process.



You are helping them identify where they need support, showing them a simpler staffing model and getting them comfortable committing to bringing a remote professional into the business.

Once the client has committed to taking on a staff member, Arkero’s talent and operations teams take over the placement process.

Life-Changing Earning Potential



This is a commission-based Growth Partner opportunity.



There is no fixed salary and there is no artificial cap on what a successful Growth Partner can build.



Your income is directly connected to the business and placements you generate.



For someone who can consistently win clients and generate placements, the earning potential can be life-changing.



And because there are no placement fees or upfront recruitment fees for the client, we have deliberately removed friction from the sales process.



The aim is to give Growth Partners a proposition that is genuinely easier to take to market.



Staffing is also not always a one-placement sale.

A business may start with one remote professional and later expand into administration, customer support, bookkeeping, sales support, marketing or other functions.



That means one strong client relationship can potentially create multiple placements and significant value over time.



The opportunity is not simply about making individual sales.



It is about building a genuine client portfolio.



Who This Suits

Back their own ability



Are confident starting conversations



Know how to build trust with business owners



Can create their own pipeline



Know how to close



Are comfortable asking for the business

Want their earning potential connected directly to their performance

Experience in business development, B2B sales, recruitment, partnerships or account management is highly valuable.



You do not need to be a recruitment expert.

Why Now

title: Long-Form Video Editor (DaVinci Resolve)
description:
Long-Form Video Editor (DaVinci Resolve) - YouTube



**Remote · Ongoing contract · Async, no live calls required**



THE ROLE



We're looking for one thing done exceptionally well: turning raw talking-head and B-roll footage into finished 7–15 minute YouTube videos for a founder-led cycling channel.



This is a long-form editing role. Not a do-everything content role. If you're strong at story structure, pacing, sound, and clean motion graphics, this is a straightforward, repeatable gig.



**Volume:** 1–2 videos per month to start. The goal is to build toward a steady bi-weekly, then weekly, cadence as the partnership proves out — so we're looking for someone who wants an ongoing seat, not a one-off.



WHAT ONE PROJECT MEANS



To be clear about what you're quoting on, one project = **one finished long-form YouTube video**:



- Source footage: **under 1 hour total**, organized, labeled, and packaged by us — you're not sifting through a card dump

- Deliverable: one 7–15 minute edited video, color graded, sound designed, music bedded

- Motion graphics: animated title cards, lower thirds, and simple on-screen text/graphics as the story calls for (typically 3–6 per video)

- Revisions: 2 rounds included

- Provided by us: script/outline, footage, music and SFX licenses, brand assets, and a Loom walkthrough of the intended story



Thumbnails and short-form clips are **not** part of this role.



PAY & PROCESS



**Step 1 — Paid trial edit: for flat fee One complete video or portion of video. Real footage, real deadline, real feedback. You get paid whether or not we continue.



**Step 2 — Ongoing per-video rate.** If the trial goes well, we set the ongoing rate together based on what the first edit actually took. As the cadence moves from monthly to bi-weekly to weekly, we expect the rate to move with the commitment.



We pay on time, every time, via [Wise / PayPal / preferred method].



TURNAROUND



We're building toward a predictable rhythm rather than a rush. Right now: **7 business days from footage handoff to first cut**, with revisions inside another 5 days. As we move to bi-weekly and then weekly, that window tightens and becomes a fixed schedule you can plan your month around. Tell us what turnaround is realistic for you — we'd rather set a pace you can hold than one you'll miss.



EDITING STYLE



Talking head and documentary-style, with occasional vlog. The edit should feel unhurried but tight — warm, cinematic, human.



- No flashy transitions. No hyperspeed jump-cut style.

- B-roll earns its place; it illustrates a point, it doesn't fill space.

- Sound is half the edit. Strong SFX work and music that carries the story, not decorates it.

- Think magazine, not vlog.



MUST HAVE

- **2–3 published long-form YouTube videos you personally edited** in a talking-head, documentary, or vlog style. For each one, tell us specifically what you handled (full edit? assembly only? graphics? sound?).

- **DaVinci Resolve** as your primary editor — you're comfortable in Fusion and Fairlight, not just the cut page.

- **Motion graphics and animated titles** you built yourself, in Fusion or After Effects.

- **Story instinct** — you can take an hour of raw material and find the 10-minute version that actually holds.

- **Sound design and music editing** — this is not an afterthought for us.

- **Strong written and spoken English.** All direction comes via async Loom; you'll reply the same way.

- Reliable internet, your own machine and software licenses.



NICE TO HAVE

- Ability to spot and cut short-form clips out of the long-form edit (we may add this as separately paid work later — mention it if you can do it, but it's not required to apply)

- Experience with outdoor, lifestyle, cycling, or endurance-sport content

- Color grading beyond a standard LUT



ABOUT ROWDEE

Rowdee is a men's cycling apparel brand built around adventure, intentional living, and the culture of riding. We're building a founder-led YouTube channel in the style of a cycling magazine — cultural commentary, history deep-dives, and authentic founder storytelling. Think GQ + Outside Magazine + Bike Mag.



HOW TO APPLY



Send:

1. Links to 2–3 long-form videos you edited, with a line on each about what you specifically did

2. Which parts of the style described above come naturally to you — and which would be a stretch

3. Your DaVinci Resolve version, realistic turnaround for a project like this, and how many of these you could handle per month at full stride



We reply to everyone who follows those four steps.

title: Web & SEO Production Lead (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
We only review applications from candidates who meet all of the qualifications listed below.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application to 
 with the subject line "Web & SEO Production Lead Application — [Your Name]" and include:



Resume highlighting your WordPress production, technical SEO, and web operations experience

Cover letter describing your relevant experience managing teams and production sites, as it relates to this role

Expected hourly rate or salary range

Available start date



About Bay Legal, PC and XPRTS



Bay Legal, PC is a full-service California law firm combining expert legal counsel with modern technology to deliver seamless, results-driven representation. XPRTS is a legal operations consulting firm helping law firms build out CRM systems, intake pipelines, and remote staffing. Together, these teams run 
, a growing portal network, and a portfolio of client websites.



Position Overview



We are seeking a high-output Web & SEO Production Lead to own WordPress production and SEO growth across 
, a large portal network, and client websites. This is a demanding execution role with clear milestones, and accountability for results.



Critically, this role is the project manager for the entire web and SEO operation — the single point of accountability who directs existing staff, keeps production and SEO work moving without constant founder involvement, and reports directly to the operations lead on progress, blockers, and results. You are the person we come to for updates.



Required Qualifications



- 4 to 7 years of hands-on experience in WordPress production, technical SEO, or web operations — required

Agency, multi-site, or large production-site experience

- Strong WordPress knowledge plus practical technical SEO experience (site structure, schema, sitemaps, canonicals, internal links, crawlability, Core Web Vitals)

- Hands-on experience working inside WP Engine and Cloudflare environments

- Familiarity with Ahrefs, SpyFu, RivalFlow AI, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and SE Ranking

- Proven ability to project manage a team and workflow end-to-end, with strong overlap with Pacific Time business hours in California

- A high-output, ownership-driven work style; this is not a low-pressure maintenance role



Key Responsibilities



- Serve as project manager for all web and SEO production, and report directly to the CEO with regular status updates on launches, traffic, output, and team performance

- Own WordPress production for BayLegal, portal properties, and client sites

- Direct designers, developers, writers, and SEO/content staff so execution does not depend on constant founder involvement

- Oversee technical SEO, including site structure, schema, sitemaps, canonicals, internal links, crawlability, and Core Web Vitals

- Work inside WP Engine and Cloudflare environments and support performance, security, and deployment workflows

- Use tools such as Ahrefs, SpyFu, RivalFlow AI, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and SE Ranking to guide production priorities and reporting

- Assess current staff, retrain where appropriate, and recommend upgrades or replacements when needed

- Help coordinate web, SEO, YouTube, and social execution where those efforts overlap

- Execute against CEO-driven milestones tied directly to launches, traffic, output, and team performance



Why This Role Stands Out



BayLegal has already demonstrated meaningful SEO growth over the past two years, and this role is designed to extend that playbook across a broader network of internal and client sites. The right candidate will step into a visible operating role with real authority, measurable goals, and room to grow into a larger leadership position.

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Short-Form Video Editor



Type: Part-time / Freelance (contract) Location: Remote Cadence: A few short-form videos per week



About Us



Excel Dictionary is an online social media platform that teaches over 9 million people Excel tips. We're growing our short-form video presence, and we're looking for a video editor who can bring energy and polish to a new content format. This isn't your typical talking-head content — you'll be cutting together a mix of on-camera segments, Excel screen recordings, and fun, fast-paced moments, all centered on practical Excel and AI tips.



If you love finding the perfect punch-in, know how to make a screen recording feel dynamic instead of static, and can turn "here's how to use XLOOKUP" into something people actually want to watch — we want to talk to you.



What You'll Do

Edit a few short-form videos per week (TikTok / Reels / Shorts format)

Blend on-camera footage with Excel screen recordings into a cohesive, watchable piece

Add captions, motion graphics, sound design, and pacing that keeps viewers hooked

Highlight key Excel and AI tips visually (callouts, zooms, cursor emphasis, etc.)

Collaborate with the content team on format, hooks, and creative direction

Keep a consistent, recognizable style across episodes while staying fresh



What We're Looking For

Proven experience editing short-form video (portfolio or reel required)

Comfort editing both live-action and screen-recorded content in the same piece

Strong sense of pacing, hooks, and what makes short-form content stop the scroll

Proficiency in an editing tool such as Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve

Bonus: familiarity with Excel, spreadsheets, or "productivity tips" content

Bonus: experience with motion graphics / basic animation (After Effects or similar)

Next Steps

We're excited to see what you'd bring to the channel!

title: Post Production VA
description:

Schedule:

Full-time

-----------------------------

About Moon Media



Love Notion? Weirdly enjoy organizing chaos? Get satisfaction from keeping projects on track and making sure nothing falls through the cracks?



You might be exactly who we're looking for. ????



Moon Media is a fast-growing creative agency producing hundreds of short-form videos every month for brands with millions of followers.



We're growing, which also means our post-production operation is getting busier.



We're looking for a highly organized Post-Production VA who can help keep everything moving behind the scenes.



This is NOT a video editing role.



You'll be the operational support behind our post-production team, keeping our Notion boards accurate, tracking priorities and deadlines, following up on blockers, preparing reports, documenting workflows, and making sure our Lead Editor and Head of Operations always know what needs attention.



If you love organization, systems, problem-solving, and being the person who keeps everyone on track, keep reading.





-----------------------------

The Role:



As our Post-Production VA, you'll work closely with our Lead Editor and Head of Operations to keep the day-to-day post-production workflow organized and visible.



Think:

What's urgent today?

What's overdue?

What needs the Lead Editor's attention?

Are editors working on the right priorities?

Is something stuck or missing?

Are our boards and reports actually accurate?



Your job is to stay on top of those details so our editors can focus on editing and leadership can focus on decisions instead of manually checking everything.



And because our entire company runs heavily on Notion, you'll be spending A LOT of time there.





-----------------------------

Responsibilities:



Post-Production Operations:

Maintain our Editors' Board and Post-Production Workflow inside Notion.

Keep video statuses, priorities, assignments, deadlines, and workflow stages accurate.

Monitor the production pipeline and catch stalled, overdue, expedited, or missing work.

Keep the Lead Editor updated on priorities, deadlines, blockers, and anything requiring attention.

Follow up with editors on routine updates, missing links, blockers, and overdue work.

Track editor productivity and prepare clear daily, weekly, and monthly reports.

Coordinate routine information between Editors, Operations, and the Lead Editor.

Help make sure leadership doesn't need to manually audit the entire workflow to know what's happening.



Documentation & Systems:

Create and maintain SOPs for post-production workflows.

Keep internal documentation, trackers, dashboards, templates, and resources organized.

Document workflows as you learn them so processes become easier to repeat and train.

Help us keep our systems clean and scalable as the team grows.



Performance & Research:

Check client social accounts and identify videos that are performing especially well.

Track and organize top-performing content for the Lead Editor and team to review.

Prepare simple reports highlighting creative wins, trends, and useful references.



Production Support:

As you grow into the role, we'll also train you to:

Assist with short-form scriptwriting.

Prepare production briefs.

Support content and creative research.

Use AI for reporting, documentation, research, and operational work.



You don't need to know everything on Day 1. We care a lot about how quickly you learn and how well you stay organized.



----------------------------------

Requirements (Non-Negotiable):



STRONG NOTION SKILLS. Our company runs heavily on Notion, so you should be comfortable with databases, linked databases, relations, filtered views, dashboards, templates, and workflow management.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Extremely organized with strong attention to detail.

Strong communication and follow-up skills.

Comfortable juggling multiple deadlines and priorities.

Able to spot problems instead of waiting for someone else to point them out.

Comfortable learning and using AI tools.

Reliable and able to work independently.



Nice to Have:



Experience supporting a creative or content team.

Experience creating SOPs and documentation.

Familiarity with Slack and Google Workspace.

Experience tracking social media performance.

Understanding of TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

Scriptwriting or production experience.





-----------------------------

Who This Role Is For:

You'll probably love this role if you're the person who looks at a messy board and immediately wants to organize it.



You notice when deadlines are getting close.



You remember the follow-up everyone else forgot.



You like knowing exactly where projects stand.



You enjoy making information easier for other people to understand.



And when someone asks, "What's the priority today?" you want to be able to answer without spending 30 minutes figuring it out.



We're not looking for someone who just checks boxes.



We're looking for someone curious, reliable, proactive, and excited to become an important part of how our post-production team operates.





-----------------------------

Why This Role Matters:

Our editors should be editing, not chasing information.



Our Lead Editor should be leading, not manually auditing boards all day.



Our Operations team should be solving bigger problems, not hunting down missing updates.



That's where you come in.



Your work will help keep hundreds of videos organized and moving through production while giving the team clear visibility into priorities, deadlines, blockers, and performance.



As Moon Media grows, you'll have the opportunity to grow with the role, learn more about content production, and become a key operational partner within the team.

title: Video editor for short form & YouTube for luxury clothing brand
description:
We are a luxury menswear brand based in London that is hiring a video editor to assist with a mix of YouTube videos and short-form content for both the brand account and the founder’s personal brand. 



The editor will work directly with the founder, who is currently doing the editing himself. For brand videos, the editor will also work with/under our cinematographer.



Everything must be done in Davinci Resolve Studio, using Blackmagic Cloud.



Time zone is not vital, but we are in London. As long as the editor is available for a few hours of overlap, we don’t care when they work.



Please only apply if you have examples of short-form and YouTube-native content. Cinematic edits with no story, dry corporate videos, and podcasts are not what we're looking for. You need experience with animations (strong preference for Fusion)(at minimum, at the caliber of Vox's explainer videos) - this isn't needed in every video, but it's needed sometimes. For each video, you'll be given a bunch of footage and audio, any relevant photos (though not necessarily exhaustive), and a spec; but you'll also have ongoing immediate back-and-forth available with the founder (who has editing experience and is involved in all shoots).





**Personal brand videos**



The founder’s personal brand is where editing will be focused in the beginning. He is a craftsman and designer and the core series will be where he explains things in clothing, tailoring, shoes and leather goods and what makes something "quality" or not, whether conceptually or by breaking down a specific product (including other’s). Content includes:



- **Shorts** that are mostly a mix of talking head + b-roll. These will need to be edited and turned around quickly to maintain a high cadence of posting. The colour grade is easy as it is already established, with the same environment & conditions being used for shooting each time. Where not provided, the editor will be expected to find b-roll to use.

- **Long-form YouTube**, which are a bit more involved. For instance, two upcoming videos:

    - ‘Learning Italian in a Week For My Shoe Brand’. There will be a lot of b-roll shot in Italy, plus talking head, plus lesson content, plus surprise reactions from the shoe factory. Has to be edited as a fast-paced documentary that still feels luxurious & restrained, focusing less on the actual learning tips (which will be present) and more on the luxury Italian vibes & the founder’s commitment to doing everything necessary for his shoes to be the best (even learning a new language). 

    - ‘How the Best Dress Shoes in the World Were Designed’. This will be at once story content, sharing how they came to be, but also a lot of instructional content that will require graphics and animation experience - eg. to create animated illustrations that shoe how shoes are made. It’s education with 6 core challenges (and their solutions) wrapped as a story. Each product we release will have a similar video.



Personal brand needs to keep some level of luxury finish, color grading, and polish, but can be a bit faster paced and internet native. There’s a balance to be struck. 





**Company videos**



As part of the company’s marketing, we will be filming the making of every single product from start to finish. At launch, this includes our shoes, a jacket, two leather bags and two leather wallets. These videos will then be cut up in many different ways:



- **Short form.** Some of these will be isolating one aspect of making a product. For instance, on the jacket, showing how the roped shoulders are attached by hand, or how the handle on the briefcase is made. Some will show the entire process, condensed into 2 minutes for product pages.

- **Long form YouTube.** Each product will have a long video showing the full process of making the product. But there will be shorter, ~8-12min long videos as well that explain different parts of the product - for instance, explaining different kinds of jacket insulation and why we chose the one we did.

- **Ads**. All of the above will eventually then be cut up for ads, though we won’t run any in the beginning.

REQUIREMENTS:



Excellent English reading comprehension and attention to detail.



Experience with web research, Google Sheets, and managing repetitive administrative pipelines accurately.



Ability to follow strict Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) without deviating.

title: Digital Marketing Executor
description:
Digital Marketing Executor



Remote · Full-Time · Long-Term · Philippines-based · No Night Shift Needed





Who We Are



We're Fresh Tech Maid (
), a Chicago residential cleaning company. We clean homes with physics, not chemicals: deionized water, hypochlorous 
 steam vapor, and HEPA filtration. Our cleaning technicians are W-2 employees — trained, background-checked, and serving families across Chicago, Evanston, and Arlington Heights. Parents with young kids, pet owners, and seniors choose us because a healthy, chemical-free home is the whole point.



Our founder has 20+ years in the service industry, a Wharton MBA, a #1 Amazon bestselling book on service-industry hiring. The marketing strategy, the content calendar, and the brand voice guide are already built. That's where you come in.



Who We Need



We need an experienced digital marketing executor. Not a trainee. Not someone starting from zero.



The strategy exists. The task list exists. The brand voice is documented. We need the person who executes it with discipline and proves it with numbers every week.



We live by the optimize — measure — learn cycle. Every project has a number. Every number gets tracked. Every result shapes what we do next. If that's how you already work, keep reading.



Are You This Person?



(1) Accountable. You own your numbers. You don't blame tools, the market, or the algorithm.

(2) Deadline-driven. You hit dates. When something slips, you flag it early.

(3) Data-first. You check dashboards before you share opinions.

(4) Measurement-minded. You think in baselines, targets, and deltas.

(5) Curious. You ask “what's working?” and “why?” every week.

(6) Honest. You say when something isn't working. No sugarcoating, no spin.



What You'll Do



You'll execute the marketing system that brings Chicago homeowners into our pipeline — leads, booked cleanings, and five-star reviews. Real projects, real numbers, real deadlines:



(1) Content engine (the core) — format and publish the weekly pillar blog (the founder provides outlines and approves every draft), refresh older posts with updated titles and section headers, and keep the content calendar on time in our documented house style.

(2) Social system — turn each pillar into platform-native posts: 3 posts per week each on
, Instagram, Google Business Profile, and YouTube. Our rules are documented and strict: at least 90% of posts carry no external link, and we publish six value posts for every one ask.

(3) LinkedIn newsletter — prepare the weekly skeleton from the latest pillar; the founder writes the final version in his own voice; you format, schedule, and track it.

(4) Link building (relationship-first) — work our researched list of 47 Chicago-area influencers across 14 content categories. Add value first, build the relationship, earn the mention. No paid placements and no cold spam blasts — we've tested that; relationships are what work.

(5) Pillar Blogs for Neighborhood pages — produce two per month in coordination with our webmaster. Quality is capped on purpose: no thin pages, no shortened clones of our pillar content.

(6) Reviews & referrals — keep our after-cleaning follow-up system supplied: the two-touch review campaign, referral credits, and QR review cards. Our client service manager owns review velocity; you own the materials and tracking behind it.

(7) Lead magnets &
 — connect our lead magnets to an
 platform (Mailchimp, ConvertKit, or similar) and run the nurture campaigns end to end.

(8) Local Services Ads pilot — in later months, help launch and track our Google Local Services Ads test against a strict cost-per-booked-job guardrail.

(9) Reporting — update the KPI workbook weekly: leads by source, geo-grid rankings, reviews across our three locations, GA4, Search Console, social insights, link status, and our rankings inside AI tools. Flag what's moving and what isn't.

(10) Team support (startup flexibility) — we're a small team, so when the week demands it, you help with admin, sales support, client service, and other tasks. Marketing is your core job, but nobody here says “that's not my job.”



Website changes, sales calls, and client delivery are led by the founder and the rest of the team — our webmaster owns the website, our sales team owns the phone, and our client service manager owns the client experience. You coordinate with them and jump in to support when asked — they own those areas; you keep marketing moving.



Every project has a goal. Every goal has a number. Every number gets reviewed.



Your Background



(1) 3+ years of real, hands-on digital marketing experience running content and social media for a business (coursework alone won't cut it). Local or consumer service brands are a plus.

(2) Strong written English — short, clear, persuasive. You'll write in the founder's documented voice, and shortlisted candidates complete a short writing sample.

(3) Hands-on social media management across
, Instagram, and YouTube. Google Business Profile experience is a plus.

(4) Basic video editing for short-form content (Descript or similar) — cutting, captioning, and formatting for vertical video.

(5) Comfort with an
 platform (Mailchimp or similar), GA4, and AI writing tools.

(6) A track record of setting goals, measuring results, and hitting targets.

(7) A 4-year Bachelor's degree.

(8) Honesty about what you know and what you still need to learn.



Nice to have: local SEO (Semrush, Google Business Profile), blogger and influencer outreach, Webflow, and home-services marketing.



How We Work (this is the deal)



(1) Daily async check-in (15 lines: what shipped yesterday, what ships today, blockers). We do not use surveillance or screen-monitoring software. We manage by visible output, not watched hours — your work must be visible: posts published,
s sent, pages live, dashboard updated.

(2) Weekly 1-hour Zoom with the founder to review the KPI dashboard.

(3) Schedule: a full-time engagement (about 40 hours/week of focused work) with 4 hours overlapping US Central mornings as a communication window.

(4) No graveyard shift: as only 4-hour overlapping, you do not need to work in graveyard shift.

(5) Dedicated, quiet workspace with reliable internet plus a backup for internet and power. This is a stay-in-place role — not a work-while-traveling role; nomad setups don't deliver the reliability this position needs.

(6) Exclusivity: this is a full-time commitment — you won't take on other clients while engaged with us.

(7) Company tools provided under a company
 we set up for you 
 platform, AI writing tools, video tools, and the rest). 



You never use personal accounts for company work.



Growth Path & Pay



This role has a clear growth ladder. As your measured results grow, your pay grows.



Level 1 (Intermediate) - $8/hour-equivalent

Level 2 (Intermediate plus) - $9/hour-equivalent

Level 3 (Advanced Specialist) - $10/hour-equivalent

Level 4 (Master Marketer) - $11/hour-equivalent

Level 5 (Authority Expert) - $12/hour-equivalent

Level 6 (Growth Partner) - $13/hour-equivalent

Level 7 (Marketing Leader) - $14/hour-equivalent

Level 8 (Marketing Leader) - $15/hour-equivalent



Because this role requires proven experience, qualified hires enter at Level 2–3 (a fixed monthly salary of roughly $1,440–$1,600) based on demonstrated skills. We pay a fixed monthly salary for the role and your availability window — not an hourly timesheet. From there we move people up based on measured results, not tenure. A modest quarterly bonus is tied to campaign outcomes (lead volume, booked cleanings, and review growth); your base never depends on outcomes outside your control.



Benefits



(1) Company-paid AI tools built into everything we do

(2) Honest, ethical managers — direct support from the founder

(3) A documented training/onboarding program (you ramp in weeks, not months)

(4) A clear path to higher pay and more responsibility

(5) 6 paid US National Holidays

(6) 5 paid personal days in Year 1; 10 from Year 2

(7) As only 4-hour overlapping, you do not need to work in graveyard shift.



Our Culture & Values



(1) Direct, honest, empathetic communication

(2) Always learning — optimize, measure, learn

(3) Data-driven, not ego-driven

(4) Team connection — no one left isolated

(5) Integrity, every time



How We Hire



This role matters to us, so we take hiring seriously:



A short survey.

A small paid work sample (a short piece written in our brand voice from an outline we provide).

A video interview with a live screen-share of a content or social campaign you personally ran — show us the numbers.

A Zoom interview with the founder.

A paid 4-week trial at full salary, with real deliverables and clear, written acceptance criteria agreed before you start. We may run this trial with more than one candidate at the same time — if so, we'll tell you openly, and everyone is paid in full. Pass the trial ? permanent, long-term role.



We're looking for one person to grow with for years — not a contractor for a month.



How to Apply?



Include the words “Chemical Free” in the first line of your application. List 3 reasons why you are a good fit.

If you've read this far and you're the disciplined, detail-driven executor we're describing, we want to hear from you.

title: Recruiting Manager - US Healthcare Staffing - Night Shift, Remote
description:
Type: Full-Time | Pay: $1,400–$1,800/month base (experience-based, night differential included) + monthly performance commission | Hours: 40/week | Schedule: Fixed US night shift, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM MST, Mon–Fri



About the Role



A US-based healthcare direct-hire staffing firm is looking for a Recruiting Manager to lead delivery for our lean, offshore recruiting team. This is not a "carry your own req" role — you'll own the funnel and the people: screening, quality control, coaching, and turning pipeline into client submissions every week. All clients and placed candidates are US-based; this is a fully remote, Philippines-based leadership seat with real authority.



You'll inherit a team already supported by AI systems that handle sourcing, list-building, outreach, and daily worklists. Your job is the part that AI can't do: screening candidates at volume, enforcing quality, coaching your recruiters, and hitting our delivery standard of 15 screened submissions per week across the team.



What You'll Own



Delivery: every submission is recruiter-screened with license/credential verification completed before it goes out — no exceptions. You're accountable for the submit-to-interview ratio and time-to-fill.



People: direct management of a Senior Recruiter and appointment setter(s), growing to a 3–5 person pod — onboarding, weekly coaching through call reviews, performance management, and making tough calls on underperformers when needed.



Cadence: running daily standups against AI-generated worklists — the day's screens, submits, and follow-ups are queued each morning; you drive execution.



Reporting: a weekly KPI scorecard to the owner covering submissions, interviews, placements, and per-recruiter production — pulled straight from the ATS.





What You Bring



-Four or more years of US healthcare staffing experience on the agency side, personally recruiting US healthcare professionals (allied health/imaging, nursing, or physicians), including direct-hire/permanent placement work.

-At least one year directly managing recruiters or sourcers — assigning reqs, owning their numbers, coaching them, and holding them accountable (not just mentoring peers).

-Fluency with recruiting metrics — you can speak confidently, fro
mory, about what strong weekly production looks like (submissions, interview rate, placements) and what your own team has delivered.

-Strong spoken English, since you'll run standups, coach recruiters live, and occasionally speak with US clients. A recorded voice sample and live spoken interview are part of our process.

-The ability to commit long-term to the fixed US night shift (8:00 AM–5:00 PM MST) with a reliable home setup: quiet space, headset, stable internet, and backup power/data.

-Comfort working in an ATS (Manatal or similar) alongside AI-driven sourcing and outreach tools.



Compensation & Growth



$1,400–$1,800/month base depending on experience, plus monthly performance commission tied to team placements — the better your pod performs, the more you earn (specifics discussed at offer). Paid reliably and on time via Wise.



This is a long-term seat with genuine authority: input on hiring, performance management, and a direct line to the owner. Clear growth path from Recruiting Manager to Head of Delivery as the team scales.



This Role Is a Strong Fit If You...



-Have hands-on US healthcare staffing/recruiting agency experience (not PH-local or non-US recruiting).

-Have directly managed recruiters — and can speak to your team's real numbers.

-Have led in a recruiting context specifically, not BPO customer service, collections, or support.

-Can commit to the fixed US night shift long-term.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with answers to the following. Applications missing the resume or any of the six answers will not be reviewed:



1. Your US healthcare staffing experience — agency name(s), years at each, which US healthcare roles you recruited, and the split between direct-hire/permanent vs. travel/contract work.



2. The team you led — how many recruiters/sourcers reported directly to you, for how long, and one real example of managing an underperformer (what you did, week by week, and the outcome).



3. Your team's numbers for one recent normal month — submissions per recruiter/week, submit-to-interview %, and placements — plus your own personal production numbers from when you carried a desk.



4. A link to a 60–90 second voice recording explaining how you'd run a 5-person US healthcare recruiting desk to 15 screened submissions/week, including your standup approach, the 3 KPIs you'd track, how you'd enforce screen quality, and your own production numbers stated out loud. This is the most important part of your application.



5. Confirmation you can commit to the fixed US night shift long-term, plus your home setup details (internet speed, headset, quiet space, backup power/internet).



6. Your current or most recent monthly pay and your earliest possible start date.

Violinists

String ensembles

Jazz musicians

Harpists

Guitarists

Live wedding music

Event entertainment

Ceremony music

Cocktail-hour music

Corporate/event musicians

your job is to identify the opportunity, gather the relevant information, and follow our approved process for responding or routing the lead.

Upcoming event ? organizer ? venue ? decision-maker ? contact information ? potential need ? CRM

Weddings

Corporate events

Galas

Fundraisers

Private events

Real estate events

Concerts

Other events where live music may be appropriate

3. Research venues we've already worked with

You will:



Research those venues.

Identify the appropriate event/wedding contacts.

Make professional phone calls when appropriate.

Introduce Velvet using an approved script.

Determine whether they have a preferred-vendor program.

Find out how we can become a recommended/preferred music provider.

Identify who makes decisions about entertainment.

What you need

You can edit simple short-form video quickly and consistently

CapCut, Premiere, or Resolve — whatever you're fastest in

A computer that can actually handle 10 exports a day

Our company operates with structured processes, modern CRM tools, and clear performance standards. We focus on long-term client relationships, consistent service quality, and building a strong, motivated remote team.

title: Exciting Sales Closer + Ops Role for Busy Residential & Commercial Cleaning Company (US Based)
description:
Read every word. There's an instruction near the bottom that gets you hired. Miss it and you're out — that's test #1, and it starts now.



We're Greater Phoenix Cleaning. We clean homes and businesses across Phoenix, Arizona, and we are on a tear — building this into a multi-seven-figure company with locations opening across the United States.



Think of us like a championship sports team. Everyone here is a starter. Everyone is accountable. We train hard, we keep score, we celebrate the wins loudly, and we don't carry passengers. If you're used to hiding in the middle of a big org where nobody notices you coasting — you will hate it here, and we'll notice fast.



We're hiring ONE leader. A Closer. Someone who can run the day-to-day of a busy cleaning company, close deals on the phone, take an angry customer and turn them into a raving fan, keep a crew of cleaners moving, and stay calm and sharp when the day goes sideways — because some days, it will.



We hire leaders, not order-takers. If you need someone telling you what to do every hour, close this post — we'll both be happier. If you see a problem and just handle it, keep reading.



THE ONE THING THAT'S NON-NEGOTIABLE

We do not hire lazy. Not "a little lazy on Fridays." Not "lazy in the parts nobody sees." If you cut corners anywhere in your life, it shows up everywhere eventually — and it has no home on this team. We want the person who does it right when no one is watching, who finishes what they start, and who is a little annoyed by their own unfinished work. If that's not you, you already know, and this will save us both time.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



Close deals. Talk to people who want their space cleaned and turn them into paying customers. Negotiate, handle objections, win. Recurring customers and raving fans are the engine of this company. One-time cleans are not. Turning the customer into a fan and a long-term friend is the goal!



Own escalations. When a customer is upset, you step in, take the heat, fix it, and save the relationship. People feel handled when they deal with you.



Run the day. Keep jobs on track, connect customers and cleaners, put out the small fires before they become big ones.

Lead the crew. Not babysit — lead. Set the standard, hold the line, help people win.



Upgrade the machine. Spot what's slow or broken and build a better way. Solve a problem once so it never comes back.



WHO YOU ARE



Happy. Real energy. People feel better after talking to you. This matters more than you'd guess.

Hungry. You want to grow, earn, and build something real. Coasting bores you.

Humble. You take hard feedback like a pro and never think you're above the work.

Sharp. Fast learner. You connect dots other people walk right past.

A leader. You've led something — a team, a shift, a project — and you were good at it. People follow you without being told to.

A self-development junkie. Books, courses, podcasts — nobody has to push you. You sharpen your craft on your own time because you actually enjoy it.

Growth mindset. "I don't know how yet." Every setback is just data.



WHY THIS BEATS A CORPORATE JOB

No red tape. No politics. No pretending to look busy. We move fast, we have fun, we treat people like adults, and we keep score honestly. You'll work directly with the owner and have a real seat at the table as we scale nationwide. The people who join early and perform are the people who lead our future locations. We build leaders here — that's the entire point.



THE HONEST PART

This is demanding. Customers can be hard, days get chaotic, and you'll be trusted with a lot, fast. If you want easy and quiet, we are not it. If you want to be pushed, to grow, to earn, and to help build something that becomes a household name across America — welcome home.



Cleaning, home-services, dispatch, or field-team experience is a real plus. But we'll take a phenomenal leader and teach them cleaning over someone who knows cleaning but can't lead. Both? Even better.



HOW TO APPLY (this is the tryout — you're going to close us on camera)

We're a sales team. So don't type us an essay — we won't read a wall of text, and neither will your future customers. Get on camera and close us. If you can't close us on hiring you, you can't close the people who pay us. It's that simple.



Two things — that's the whole application:



-Put the word DESERT in the first line of your message so we know you read this. No DESERT, no reply. (Test #1 — passed or failed before we even hit play.)



-Record a 2–3 minute video of YOURSELF ON CAMERA — face visible. Not a voice-only clip. Not just your screen. You, talking to the lens like it's a customer who just said "let me think about it." Loom, YouTube unlisted, Google Drive — paste the link. In it, close us:

1. Who you are and why you're a leader, not an order-taker. Ten seconds. Don't ramble — tight is a skill.

2. One time you turned an angry customer or a bad situation completely around. Specifics. What you did, how it ended.

3. What you're doing right now to get better at your craft — the last book, course, or podcast you finished and the one thing you actually changed.

4. Then close. Ask us for the job. Handle the objection out loud: "Why you over everyone else applying?" Sell us. Don't be shy — that's the entire test.



No cover letter. No essay. If the video isn't there — or it's a black screen with a voice — we skip it, no exceptions. The people who won't get on camera are exactly the people we don't want on the phone.



We watch every video that comes in with DESERT. Show us the close.



Let's go build something big.



— The Greater Phoenix Cleaning Team
