title: AI Data Evaluators & Video Annotators
description:
We're looking for experienced AI evaluators to join us on a set of active projects. The work is multimodal — images, video, and audio — and accuracy matters more than speed.



What you'll be doing:



Head-to-head evals — comparing two AI-generated images or videos and rating them on instruction following, visual quality, motion/temporal quality, audio sync, and how "AI generated" they look. Also comparing live speech-to-speech responses on naturalness, utility, and delivery.

Detailed video captioning — writing timestamped, comprehensive captions covering scene composition, objects per character, every motion and reaction, camera movement, and all dialogue. The standard is strict: no omissions, no hallucinations. If it's visible, it's annotated. If it's annotated, it's visible.

Grounded annotation tasks — entity tagging, exact-product verification, visible-text transcription, AI-artifact review, camera movement analysis, and audio transcript correction.

Adversarial question writing — designing realistic, web-dependent research questions that stump frontier models, then documenting the "gold" path to the correct answer with reliable sources.



Who we're looking for:



You've done this kind of work before — Handshake AI, Micro1, Outlier, Scale, Mercor, Surge, DataAnnotation, or similar.

You can follow a rubric precisely instead of going with your gut. You know that the prettier image isn't automatically the one that followed instructions, and that "both are fine" isn't a valid tie.

Strong written English and real attention to detail.

Reliable turnaround and consistent availability.



To apply, please send:



A short portfolio or work samples showing similar eval/annotation work you've done, and which platforms you did it on.

Any onboarding assessments you've passed, plus your quality scores or ratings if you have them.





Applications without a portfolio or platform history won't be reviewed. If you've only done basic transcription or generic data entry, this likely isn't the right fit.

title: Experienced Real Estate Cold Caller / ISA – Motivated Seller Leads | $6–$7/hr + Appointment & Closing Bonuses
description:
OnlyOffers is a Chicago-based real estate solutions and home-buying company.



We speak with homeowners who may be dealing with situations such as:



* A property that needs major repairs

* Problem tenants or nonpaying occupants

* An inherited or probate property

* Pre-foreclosure or financial pressure

* A vacant or boarded property

* Tax or code issues

* An unwanted rental property

* Divorce, relocation or another life transition

* A desire to sell as-is without preparing the property for the traditional market



Depending on the homeowner’s situation, our local team may discuss a direct purchase, an as-is sale, a traditional real estate listing or another legitimate option.



We are not looking for someone who pressures homeowners or simply reads a script. We need someone who listens carefully, asks intelligent questions, recognizes genuine motivation and schedules qualified conversations for our local team.



This is intended to be a stable, long-term position with the opportunity to grow into a Senior ISA or Lead Manager as OnlyOffers expands.



-----



YOUR ROLE



You will be the first voice many homeowners hear from OnlyOffers.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Making outbound calls to property owners using our company-provided dialer

* Having professional, natural conversations with Chicago-area homeowners

* Identifying whether the owner is open to discussing a sale

* Asking appropriate discovery questions about:

    * Reason for considering a sale

    * Desired timeline

    * Property condition and needed repairs

    * Whether the property is occupied, vacant or tenant-occupied

    * Tenant or eviction-related complications

    * Ownership and other decision-makers

    * Price expectations, when appropriate

* Recognizing motivated sellers without forcing or misleading them

* Scheduling qualified appointments or callbacks with our acquisitions or real estate team

* Completing assigned follow-up calls

* Sending approved SMS or
 follow-ups through company systems when assigned

* Recording accurate notes, dispositions, tags and follow-up tasks in the CRM

* Keeping every lead organized so no legitimate opportunity is lost

* Submitting an accurate end-of-shift report

* Immediately recording and honoring every do-not-call request

* Following all OnlyOffers calling, privacy and compliance procedures



We provide the lead lists, dialer, CRM, scripts, training and qualification process.



-----



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO



You will not:



* Quote a cash offer or property value

* Estimate what a property is worth

* Negotiate purchase prices or contract terms

* Give legal, tax, foreclosure or eviction advice

* Promise that OnlyOffers will purchase a property

* Misrepresent the company or the purpose of the call

* Continue calling someone who has asked not to be contacted



Those matters are handled by our acquisitions team, licensed real estate professionals or appropriate third-party professionals.



Your responsibility is to start a genuine conversation, collect accurate information and make a professional handoff.



-----



WHAT COUNTS AS A QUALIFIED APPOINTMENT



A $25 appointment bonus is earned only when all of the following are true:



1. You spoke with the property owner or a confirmed decision-maker.

2. The property is within an approved OnlyOffers market or campaign.

3. The homeowner expressed genuine openness to selling or discussing available options.

4. There is a real timeline, reason, problem or circumstance behind the potential sale.

5. You collected the required property and seller information.

6. Clear and accurate notes were entered in the CRM.

7. The homeowner agreed to a specific appointment or callback time.

8. The scheduled conversation was actually held by our team.



Duplicate leads, existing active leads, fake appointments, homeowners who were misled or appointments missing required information do not qualify for the bonus.



Quality is more important than simply placing appointments on the calendar.



-----



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



After training and ramp-up, reasonable performance targets may include:



* Consistent high-volume outbound activity during assigned calling blocks

* Approximately 10–25 real homeowner conversations per day, depending on list and dialer performance

* Approximately 3–8 legitimate seller opportunities per week

* Approximately 1–4 qualified appointments held per week

* Accurate same-day CRM notes and follow-up tasks

* Reliable attendance and punctuality

* Professional communication with the OnlyOffers team

* Immediate and accurate handling of do-not-call requests



These targets may be adjusted based on list quality, connection rate, campaign type and dialer setup. We do not reward meaningless dials or unqualified leads.



-----



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



To be considered, you must have:



* At least one year of outbound calling, appointment setting or inside-sales experience

* Previous experience calling U.S. homeowners

* Previous U.S. real-estate cold-calling experience

* Experience identifying seller motivation, timeline, condition and price expectations

* Experience handling objections without sounding robotic or aggressive

* Clear, confident and easy-to-understand spoken English

* Strong listening and note-taking skills

* Experience working inside a CRM

* Experience using a power dialer or real-estate calling platform

* Reliable attendance during U.S. Central Time business hours

* A professional, quiet work environment

* A reliable computer and quality USB or noise-cancelling headset

* Stable high-speed Internet with a backup Internet option

* A backup plan for power interruptions



Experience working for a real-estate investor, wholesaler, cash-home-buying company or acquisitions team is strongly preferred.



-----



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE



Experience with any of the following is a major plus:



* Follow Up Boss

* GoHighLevel

* REsimpli

* Podio

* ReadyMode

* CallTools

* BatchDialer

* Mojo

* BatchLeads

* PropStream

* Absentee-owner lists

* Tired-landlord lists

* Pre-foreclosure

* Probate or inherited-property leads

* Vacant-property leads

* Expired listings or FSBOs

* SMS and
 follow-up

* Chicago or Midwest homeowners

* Conversational Spanish



Follow Up Boss experience is especially valuable.



-----



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit when:



* You can follow a call framework without sounding like you are reading

* You listen more than you speak

* You ask a thoughtful second question instead of immediately giving up

* You remain professional when someone is rude or dismissive

* You can hear the difference between curiosity and genuine motivation

* You do not manufacture or exaggerate leads

* You are comfortable receiving coaching and reviewing your calls

* You keep excellent notes without being reminded

* You take responsibility for your attendance and results

* You want one stable, long-term role rather than constantly changing clients



This is a direct-hire position. No agencies, subcontractors or applicants working overlapping full-time shifts.



-----



SCHEDULE



Monday through Friday



10:00 AM–7:00 PM U.S. Central Time



One-hour unpaid meal break



40 paid working hours per week



This is an overnight/graveyard schedule in the Philippines. The Philippine schedule changes when U.S. daylight-saving time changes.



Consistent availability during the complete shift is required.



-----



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



* Starting compensation: $6–$7 USD per hour, depending on verified experience and interview performance

* Paid training at your regular hourly rate

* $25 for each qualified appointment that is actually held

* $250 for every transaction generated from your original lead that successfully closes

* Compensation review after the first 90 days

* Additional reviews based on reliability, call quality, CRM accuracy and results

* Payments every two weeks

* 13th-month loyalty bonus after 12 consecutive months in good standing

* Five paid personal days after six months

* Long-term opportunity

* Advancement opportunity into Senior ISA or Lead Manager

* Additional responsibility and compensation as the OnlyOffers calling team expands



Closing bonuses are paid after the transaction has successfully closed and OnlyOffers has received the applicable transaction proceeds.



-----



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY



Applications missing any required item will not be reviewed.



Begin your application with the words:



ONLYOFFERS CHICAGO



Then provide all of the following:



1. Your full name and current city in the Philippines.

2. Your résumé.

3. A two- to three-minute video using Loom, Google Drive or an unlisted YouTube link. The link must be accessible without requesting permission.



Your video must include:



* A brief introduction

* Your U.S. real-estate cold-calling experience

* The types of seller lists you have called

* A natural response to the following homeowner:



“I’m not interested. Everybody keeps calling me. Besides, I have a tenant who won’t leave and the property needs too much work, so selling isn’t simple.”



Do not read a prepared answer. Respond naturally and demonstrate what you would say next, including at least two follow-up questions.



4. Written answers to the following:



* How many months or years have you cold called U.S. homeowners?

* Have you worked for a wholesaler, investor or cash-home-buying company?

* Which seller lists have you called?

* Which CRMs have you used?

* Which dialers have you used?

* What were your average daily dials?

* What were your average weekly homeowner conversations, qualified leads and appointments?

* How do you determine whether a seller is hot, warm or cold?

* What would you do immediately if a homeowner asks never to be called again?

* Are you currently working for another client or employer?

* Can you work the complete U.S. Central Time schedule without overlapping work?

* What is your primary Internet speed?

* What is your backup Internet plan?

* What is your backup plan during a power interruption?

* What computer and headset do you use?

* When are you available to begin?



5. A screenshot of your current Internet speed test.

6. A screenshot of your computer specifications.



Applicants who complete the first stage may be invited to a live video interview and real-time seller role-play.



We are hiring carefully because we want the right person to become a long-ter
mber of OnlyOffers—not simply someone to read a script and make calls.

title: Credit Repair Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Credit Repair Assistant to join our team. The ideal candidate has a strong background in credit repair, consumer protection laws, and current, legally compliant dispute practices. This is a remote position for someone who can work independently, manage multiple client files, and deliver accurate, high-quality work.



Responsibilities

Review credit reports from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.

Prepare factual, consumer law-based dispute letters and supporting documentation.

Process identity theft-related disputes when supported by appropriate documentation.

Handle disputes involving unauthorized or inaccurately reported hard inquiries when supported by the facts.

Manage and update client files using DisputeFox.

Monitor dispute timelines and follow up with clients and credit bureaus.

Maintain detailed case notes and ensure all client information remains confidential.

Stay current with consumer protection laws, credit bureau procedures, and effective, legally compliant dispute methods.

Contact credit bureaus and creditors on behalf of clients, when properly authorized, to request expedited corrections or removals via FTC, 24 inquiry removal etc via all three consumer reporting agencies.



Required Qualifications

Minimum 2 years of hands-on credit repair experience.

Experience using DisputeFox is required.

Strong knowledge of the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), and other applicable consumer protection laws.

Experience preparing factual, consumer law-based disputes.

Experience handling identity theft-related disputes.

Experience disputing unauthorized or inaccurate hard inquiries using factual documentation and applicable consumer protection laws.

Familiarity with current, legally compliant dispute strategies used in today's credit repair industry.

Demonstrated experience contacting the credit bureaus on behalf of clients (with proper authorization) to request expedited investigation or removal of unauthorized or inaccurate hard inquiries when appropriate.

Experience with time-sensitive hard inquiry removal workflows, including requesting expedited processing through the bureaus when supported by the facts.

Excellent written communication, organization, and attention to detail.

Ability to work independently while managing multiple client files.

Experience disputing via online portals Experian, Transunion and Equifax via Idenity Theft and factual based disputing.

24 hour inquiry removal via all three consumer reporting agencies.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Metro 2 reporting compliance.

Familiarity with CFPB complaint procedures.

Knowledge of credit bureau investigation processes.

Ability to identify reporting inaccuracies and prepare customized, fact-based dispute strategies.

What We're Looking For

We're seeking someone who understands today's credit repair industry and is committed to ethical, compliant credit repair practices. The ideal candidate stays informed about changing bureau procedures and consumer protection laws and knows how to prepare individualized, factual disputes supported by documentation.



Applicants must have real-world experience working directly with the credit bureaus to obtain expedited resolutions when appropriate. This includes experience calling the bureaus on behalf of authorized clients to request expedited investigation or removal of unauthorized or inaccurate hard inquiries when the facts support such requests.



When Applying, Please Include

Your years of credit repair experience.

Your experience using DisputeFox.

A summary of your experience with factual disputes, identity theft disputes, unauthorized hard inquiry disputes, and expedited hard inquiry removal requests made directly with the credit bureaus.

Your availability.

Your hourly rate or salary expectations.

Only applicants with verifiable credit repair experience, DisputeFox experience, and demonstrated experience handling expedited hard inquiry removal requests with the credit bureaus will be considered.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a 
nt to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 50 wp
ans you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 10 – August 20

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A screenshot of your typing test results (
)

- A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net)

- A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit

- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren



---

title: AI Voiceover Specialist for E-commerce Video Ads
description:
We are looking for an AI Voiceover Specialist to create realistic, high-quality voiceovers for e-commerce video ads.

You will be given scripts and will be responsible for generating natural-sounding AI voiceovers that match the tone, pacing, emotion, and style of the advertisement.



 Responsibilities include:



* Create realistic AI voiceovers from provided scripts

* Use tools such as ElevenLabs or similar AI voice platforms

* Adjust pacing, emotion, pauses, emphasis, and pronunciation

* Match different customer avatars such as moms, dads, older adults, men, women, etc.

* Produce multiple voice variations when requested

* Deliver clean, high-quality audio files quickly

* Follow references/examples of winning ads we provide



 Requirements:



 * Experience with ElevenLabs or other AI voice generators

 * Strong understanding of natural UGC-style voices

 * Ability to make AI voices sound human and not robotic

 * Fast turnaround time

 * Good English communication

 * Experience with e-commerce/DTC advertisements is preferred

title: Meta Ads Specialist - Lead Generation (Part Time, Long Term)
description:
Studio Republic is a boudoir and empowerment photography studio based in Southeast Queensland, Australia. We were founded in 2009 and we've now photographed more than 17,000 women.



We're not really a photography business. We're a confidence business that happens to use a camera. Women come to us nervous, often after years of avoiding photos of themselves, and they leave seeing themselves differently. That's the work. The photos are just how it happens.



We're a small, close team and we care a lot about doing things properly. Our Meta advertising is how most of our clients find us, so this role matters enormously to the business.



The role:

You'll be running our Meta ad account day to day — building campaigns, managing budgets, watching delivery, spotting problems early, and working directly with the management on strategy. 



This is lead generation for a high-value service, not e-commerce. There's no shopping cart and no instant purchase. A woman sees an ad, submits an enquiry, gets a phone call, books a session weeks later, and attends a few weeks after that. Success isn't measured in cheap clicks — it's measured in women who actually walk through the door and spend.



If you've only run product sales campaigns, this wont be the right fit. 

What you'll be doing



  -  Building and managing lead generation campaigns end to end

  -  Managing daily budgets and delivery across multiple campaigns

  -  Monitoring the account every weekday and flagging issues before we have to ask

  -  Reporting weekly on performance, with clear reasoning behind every recommendation

  -  Working with our closed-loop data (we track every lead through to attendance and revenue) and using it to make decisions

  -  Testing creative properly — with enough budget and enough time to actually learn something

  -  Explaining what you're doing in plain English, not Meta jargon



What we need from you:



Non-negotiable:



 * Minimum 5 years, proven experience with service-based lead generation. Coaching, health, beauty, professional services, high-ticket appointments. Please don't apply if your experience is only e-commerce or dropshipping.

 * Go High Level expert

 * Deep, genuine Meta knowledge. Campaign structure, CBO and ABO, learning phase, audience overlap, attribution windows, custom and lookalike audiences, Instant Forms, pixel and conversions API, location targeting. You should be able to explain why, not just what.

  * Excellent written and spoken English. You'll be on calls and
s with management often. Communication is at least half this job.

  *  Available during Australian business hours, 8am–5pm AEST (Brisbane time). This is not negotiable and it is not a night-shift-optional role.

   * Contactable 7 days a week for genuine emergencies. Not working weekends — just reachable if the account breaks.

   * Attention to detail. Small mistakes in Meta cost real money. We need someone who checks their own work.



Just as important:



   * You tell us when something has gone wrong, including when it was your mistake. We would much rather hear "I set that up incorrectly and here's the fix" than have to find it ourselves.

   * You push back when you think we're wrong, and you bring evidence when you do.

   *  You're comfortable being measured on business outcomes — cost per booking, attendance rate, revenue — not just cost per lead.



This is probably not for you if...

    You manage six or seven accounts and this would be your seventh

    You'd rather send a dashboard than have a conversation

    You're uncomfortable being asked to explain your reasoning

    Your answer to underperformance is usually "the algorithm needs more time"



Hours and pay

    $1,000 AUD per month

    Available to work with management between 8am and 5pm Brisbane time

    Contactable 7 days

    Long term role — we want someone who'll grow with us, not a short contract



How to apply

- Send us a video. Maximum 3 minutes. Applications without a video won't be considered.



In your video, please cover:

    1. Who you are and why this role suits you

    2. The service-based lead gen work you've done — what industry, what results, what you were actually responsible for

    3. This question: A lead generation campaign is running on $200 per day. It has 12 ad sets, and each ad set contains 8 ads. Cost per lead has been climbing for three weeks. What's the first thing you'd change, and why?



We're not looking for a polished production. We're looking for how you think and how you communicate. Speak to us like you'd speak to us on a normal work call.



Please also include:

    1. Your CV or a summary of relevant experience

    2. One example of an account you improved, with real numbers

    2. Your available hours in Brisbane time

description:
High-Performance Reactive Scheduling & Dispatch Role



We are looking for an experienced Scheduler to take control of the daily scheduling and dispatch operations for Plumbing Bros Corporate (Perth).



This is NOT an administration role with some scheduling responsibilities. Scheduling and dispatch must be your primary experience.



We are specifically looking for someone who has worked in plumbing, electrical, HVAC, maintenance, pest control, or another high-volume home services environment, where you have been responsible for scheduling technicians, taking customer calls, creating jobs/orders, and constantly adjusting the schedule throughout the day.



If your background is primarily general administration, data entry, customer service, or virtual assistance without substantial scheduling/dispatch experience, please do not apply.



ABOUT THE ROLE



You will be the command centre of our daily operations.

This is a fast-paced, reactive environment with a high volume of incoming calls and jobs.

You need to be comfortable doing multiple things at once:



???? Taking customer and technician calls

???? Creating orders/jobs in the system while on the phone

???? Scheduling and dispatching technicians

???? Rebuilding schedules when priorities change

???? Responding quickly to urgent jobs and changing circumstances

???? Managing technician locations, availability, and job runs



The day will not always go according to plan — and that's exactly why we need an experienced reactive Scheduler.

You must be able to think on your feet, make decisions quickly, and keep control of the schedule even when the phone is constantly ringing.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Scheduling & Dispatch

Schedule and dispatch plumbers across daily job runs

Allocate jobs based on technician availability, location, skills and priority

Manage a high volume of jobs without losing control or accuracy

Monitor technician progress throughout the day

Adjust schedules in real time as jobs run over, cancel, become urgent or change priority

Minimise technician downtime and unnecessary travel

Keep technicians productive and moving throughout the day

Identify gaps in the schedule and proactively fill them

High-Volume Calls & Customer Coordination

Answer a high volume of incoming calls

Speak confidently and professionally with customers and technicians

Gather the information required to create accurate jobs/orders

Create orders/jobs while speaking with customers on the phone

Determine job urgency and prioritise appropriately

Manage customer expectations around availability and arrival times

Handle changes, cancellations and urgent requests quickly

Communicate schedule changes to technicians and customers



Reactive Operations

This is one of the most important parts of the role.

You need to be able to react immediately when the plan changes.



For example:

A plumber is running 45 minutes late ? you need to immediately assess the schedule, contact affected customers, rearrange jobs and keep the rest of the day moving.

An emergency job comes through ? you need to determine priority, identify the appropriate technician and reorganise the schedule.

A technician finishes early ? you need to identify the next suitable job and get them moving.

A customer cancels ? you need to identify how to use that newly available time.

You cannot wait for someone else to tell you what to do.



THIS ROLE REQUIRES MULTITASKING

You need to be comfortable with:

???? Phone ringing

???? Creating an order

???? Updating the schedule

???? Checking technician availability

???? Communicating with technicians

???? Responding to urgent jobs

???? Reorganising the day's schedule

— all at the same time.



If you become overwhelmed when several things happen simultaneously, this role will not be a good fit.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



???? SCHEDULING / DISPATCH EXPERIENCE IS ESSENTIAL



Your primary professional experience must be in scheduling, dispatch, or service coordination.

We are specifically looking for candidates with experience scheduling technicians in industries such as:

???? Plumbing

? Electrical

?? HVAC / Air Conditioning

???? Home Services

????? Maintenance Services

???? Pest Control

???? Automotive / Mobile Services

Other high-volume field service businesses

Strongly Preferred

Experience scheduling plumbers or electricians

Experience in a high-volume service environment

Experience handling a high volume of inbound calls

Experience creating jobs/orders while speaking with customers

Experience dispatching technicians

Experience managing same-day and urgent jobs

Experience with Ascora is highly advantageous

Experience with other field-service/job-management software

Understanding of technician territories, travel time and job allocation



DO NOT APPLY IF...

? Scheduling has not been your primary experience.

? Your experience is primarily general administration.

? Your experience is primarily data entry.

? Your experience is primarily bookkeeping or finance.

? Your experience is primarily customer service without scheduling/dispatch responsibilities.

? You have only occasionally helped with scheduling.

? You have never managed technician schedules.

? You have never worked in a high-volume service environment.

We are not looking to train someone from scratch in scheduling.

We need someone who can step into the role and operate confidently from Day 1.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The right person will:

Have significant hands-on scheduling/dispatch experience

Understand how plumbing/electrical/home service businesses operate

Be highly reactive and comfortable with constant change

Think 2–3 steps ahead

Make quick, sensible decisions

Remain calm when the phone is constantly ringing

Have excellent attention to detail

Be extremely organised

Have a strong sense of urgency

Take ownership rather than waiting for instructions

Communicate clearly and confidently

Be comfortable challenging inefficient processes

Understand that getting the right technician to the right job at the right time matters

WORKING HOURS

Monday – Friday

???? 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Perth Time

1-hour unpaid lunch break

Optional paid overtime may be available depending on workload.

WHY JOIN US?

Work with a growing national Australian brand

Become a critical part of the daily operations team

Work within structured systems and processes

High-performance environment with clear expectations

Opportunity to make a measurable impact on operational performance

Work alongside an experienced operations team

Clear accountability and ownership

FINAL NOTE — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

This is a high-pressure, high-responsibility scheduling role.

Our phones can be busy. Jobs can change. Technicians can run late. Emergency work can come in. Customers need updates. Orders need to be created.

You need to be able to handle all of this without losing control.

We are looking for a reactive Scheduler — not an administrator who can schedule.

If your primary experience is scheduling and dispatching technicians in plumbing, electrical, home services, or another high-volume field-service environment, we want to hear from you.

If scheduling is not your primary experience, please do not apply.

title: Brand Partnerships Coordinator
description:
About Jawology (
)

Jawology is an Australian direct-to-consumer clear aligner and retainer brand based in Brisbane, Queensland. We

help people straighten their teeth from home, with treatment plans reviewed and monitored by registered

clinicians, aligners manufactured by our partner lab, and progress tracked through remote scan monitoring.

Customers can start their journey with an at-home impression kit or an in-clinic 3D scan at one of our partner clinics

around Australia.

We are a small, fast-moving team and this role will work closely with the founder on two connected growth areas:

our ambassador/creator program, and our partner clinic network.



The Role

We're looking for someone to own two related relationship-management functions for Jawology. Both involve

reaching out to people, building rapport, explaining our offer clearly, and managing the relationship through to a

result - so while the two halves of the role sound different, the core skill set (organised, warm written

communication, follow-up discipline) is the same.



Part 1: Influencer & Ambassador Outreach

Jawology runs an ambassador program where content creators and influencers document their clear aligner

journey and share it with their audience, in exchange for heavily discounted or fully complimentary treatment. This

person will run that program day to day.

• Proactively find and reach out to suitable influencers/content creators (Instagram-first, open to other

platforms) who'd be a good fit to represent Jawology.

• Manage the inbox/DMs of influencers who reach out to us wanting to collaborate - we currently have more

inbound interest than we have time to respond to.

• Walk each creator through the two program options and help them pick the right one:

• Full ambassador journey: the creator receives heavily discounted or complimentary treatment and

documents their journey over time in exchange for content and social promotion.

• Impression kit only: for creators who aren't ready to commit to full treatment, we send an impression kit so

they can film unboxing/first-impression content without joining the full program.

• Negotiate and confirm deliverables and terms with each creator, using our standard creator agreement and

deliverables framework.

• Keep a simple tracker of every creator relationship - stage, agreed deliverables, content received, follow-up

dates.

• Chase content deliverables and follow-ups so creators actually post what they agreed to.

• Flag any creator with a large or notable following, or any unusual/high-value request, to the founder before

agreeing to terms.



Part 2: Partner Clinic Outreach

Jawology works with partner clinics around Australia who offer in-clinic 3D scans, and support treatment steps like

IPR (interproximal reduction) and attachment placement for our patients. This person will help us grow that clinic

network.

• Research and reach out to dental clinics across Australia to introduce Jawology and gauge interest in becoming

a partner clinic.

• Clearly explain what partnering involves - offering 3D scans for prospective patients, and where relevant, IPR

and attachment placement for patients already in treatment.

• Answer initial questions and qualify interested clinics before handing off to the founder for agreement and

onboarding.

• Help coordinate onboarding logistics for newly signed clinics (sending agreements, confirming details) once

terms are agreed.



What We're Looking For

• Excellent written English - warm, clear, and professional. This role is almost entirely written communication.

• Experience with outreach, sales development, partnerships, influencer/creator management, or account

management.

• Comfortable with cold outreach and following up without being pushy.

• Highly organised - able to manage many relationships/conversations at once without things slipping through

the cracks.

• Confident using Instagram/social platforms,
, and simple spreadsheet or CRM-style trackers.

• Self-directed - able to work independently and flag things that need the founder's input rather than guessing.

• Bonus: prior experience in influencer marketing, healthcare/dental, beauty, or another appearance-focused

D2C brand.



What Success Looks Like

• A steadily growing, well-managed pipeline of ambassador creators actively posting Jawology content.

• No inbound influencer messages left unanswered for more than a day or two.

• A growing number of partner clinics signed on across Australian states.

• Clean, up-to-date tracking so the founder can see program status at a glance.

title: Graphic Designer (Canva) – Wedding Designs & Client Approvals (Excellent English Required)
description:
TYPE OF WORK: Part Time WAGE / SALARY: $5.50 per hour HOURS PER WEEK: 15





JOB OVERVIEW

We're a growing events business based in Ireland and the UK, and we're looking for a Canva designer who's just as comfortable talking to clients as they are laying out a design.



Every couple who books with us gets a custom design created for their wedding. It's the part of our service people get most excited about, so getting it right matters.



You'd own that whole piece: building the design, sending it to the couple, gathering their feedback, making the tweaks, and getting a clear sign-off before the event. Most of it runs off our existing Canva master template, so this isn't a blank-canvas design job. It's careful, accurate template work plus the confidence to handle a logo, a layout tweak or a slightly unusual request without needing to ask about every small thing.



Weddings are the bulk of the work. There's occasional corporate and other events too.



**What you'll do**

- Build each client's design in Canva from our master template (names, chosen design style, fonts, venue illustration, any supplied logo or photo)

- Proof your own work carefully. Names spelled right, dates right, everything aligned

- Export and
 the design to the client for approval, in our tone of voice

- Handle revision rounds. Font changes, spelling fixes, a different design option, logo sizing, colour tweaks

- Chase clients who've gone quiet so designs don't drift toward the event date

- Get a clear written sign-off from every client before the event

- Export approved designs in the formats our on-the-day team needs

- Keep our Google Sheet and HubSpot updated at each stage so everyone can see where a booking stands

- Flag anything unusual or fully custom to us before starting on it





**What we're looking for**

- Excellent written English. You'll be
ing brides and grooms directly, so this is the #1 requirement

- Strong Canva skills and a genuinely good eye for spacing, alignment and type

- Extremely detail-focused. A misspelled surname on a wedding design is the one mistake we can't have

- Comfortable owning a client conversation from first draft to sign-off, politely and warmly

- Organised enough to juggle 10-20 live designs at different stages without losing track of any of them

- Reliable, proactive, and happy to follow a clear process





**Comfortable using**

- Canva (template edits, layout adjustments, importing logos and images)

- Gmail (client correspondence, labelling, organising)

- HubSpot (updating deal stages and contact records)

- Google Sheets (our bookings tracker is the system of record)

- AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini)





**Nice to have**

- Experience designing for weddings, events or hospitality

- Prior client-facing design or account management work with international clients

- Basic illustration ability (we build venue illustrations and occasionally need new ones)

- Bonus points if you can structure some of your hours to overlap with UK/Ireland time





**How the work is paced**

- Designs go out within 48 hours of a client sending us their details, and they're finished 1-2 months ahead of the wedding. That means the workload is steady rather than frantic, but nothing can be left to sit. We'd rather you flag a delay early than let a design creep toward the event date.



**HOURS**

10-15 hours per week to start, with the opportunity for more as we grow. This is a long-term role with consistent hours.



**PERFORMANCE INCENTIVE**

To reward consistency and commitment, we offer a bonus of $250 paid after successfully completing 90 days in the role. This is paid in full once the trial period is completed.



To apply

Send us:

A short note in your own words about a design project where you dealt directly with the client

Two or three examples of Canva work you've done (wedding or event work especially welcome)



Please put the word PRINT at the top of your application so we know you've read the full post.

mbers can learn from them

About the role



I run a US-based digital agency with several brands and ventures under it. The businesses are healthy. The bottleneck is me: I move fast, work across multiple projects at once, and need one excellent person whose job is keeping all of it organized, tracked, and moving.



This is not an admin task list. I'm looking for the person who becomes my operational right hand.



What you'll actually do



- Build and maintain the system that tracks everything in motion across my businesses (your tools of choice; you'll have freedom here)

- Turn my voice notes, calls, and quick messages into organized action items, and make sure none of them die

- Follow up with my team and vendors so things get done without me chasing

- Prep my day and my week: what's open, what's stalled, what I owe people, what needs a decision

- Review outgoing work for errors before it ships: typos, wrong date formats, currency mistakes, anything that would look off to an American audience

- The role spans several businesses plus some personal organization. You'll be the one person who sees the whole picture.



Who this fits



- You've supported a founder, CEO, or agency owner directly for at least 2 years, and you can describe the systems you built for them

- Excellent written AND spoken English. We'll talk on calls regularly, and you'll write messages on my behalf.

- You're proactive to the point of being slightly annoying about follow-ups, but low-maintenance with my time. You take direction, run quietly, and come back with it done. Updates are short and clear. I'm looking for a silent partner who executes, not someone who needs meetings about meetings.

- You catch what others miss. Typos, formatting inconsistencies, and small errors genuinely bother you.

Comfortable with tools like Notion, ClickUp, Trello, Slack, Google Workspace, and quick to learn whatever a task needs

- You build automations, not just use tools. If you've connected systems with Zapier or Make, built a Notion or ClickUp setup from scratch, or used AI to eliminate repetitive work, tell me about it in your application.



The growth path



Part-time to start, around 20 hours a week, on purpose: we both make sure it's a great fit. The plan is full-time within 60-90 days if it's working, and you'll recieve a pay review at 90 days. I'm looking for someone long-term. I've run my agency for 18 years and keep clients and people for years, not months.



How to apply



Start your application with the word COMPASS so I know you read this. Applications will be reviewed starting 14/08/2026. Then include:



1. A short description of a founder or executive you supported: what you owned, and one system you personally built for them

2. One automation or system you built that saved someone real time, and how it worked

3. This post contains three small errors that an American reader would catch. List all three.

4. A link to a 2-3 minute Loom or video introducing yourself (this role requires strong spoken English, so this is part of the application)

5. Your available hours (Eastern Time overlap matters for this role)



Shortlisted candidates get a small paid test project ($30,00, paid either way) before any final decision.



Applications without COMPASS, the three errors, or the video link won't be considered.

title: IG Reels Video Editor
description:
We’re on the hunt for a Reels editor who gets it — someone who doesn’t just slap clips together, but knows how to create energy, emotion, and engagement. If you live on Instagram, can predict trends before they peak, and know what feels right for a brand, we want you.



About Us



Talent Tribe Media, powered by Nexus Hawaii, is a full-force creative team that works with Hawaii’s top influencers, brands, and business leaders. We craft digital content that captures the island vibe with world-class quality — authentic, aesthetic, and built for engagement.



We’re expanding, and we want a video editor who can keep up with both Hawaii’s chill energy and fast-paced social media trends.



Your Role



-Edit Instagram Reels (and occasionally TikToks) that align with each brand’s voice and audience.

-Translate raw clips into scroll-stopping content that drives engagement and conversions.

-Stay up to date with current audio, transitions, trends, and hooks — and bring fresh ideas to the table.

-Collaborate with our creative team in Hawaii time — be responsive, communicative, and ready to move when inspiration strikes.

-Maintain consistency in branding, pacing, and storytelling across all deliverables.



The role is project-based, typically around 2–3 hours of paid output per project, with a 24-hour turnaround for final edits. It’s not a fixed schedule or salaried position, but more on an as-needed basis depending on project availability.



You’re Perfect For This If You:



-Have proven experience editing Reels or short-form videos (send your portfolio — we actually check it).

-Are fluent in Instagram culture: trends, algorithms, aesthetics, and audience psychology.

-Have a solid sense of timing, rhythm, and emotional pull.

-Know how to adapt your editing style to different brands or industries.

-Have good work ethics — meaning you meet deadlines, communicate clearly, and take feedback professionally.

-Can work independently but thrive in a team that moves fast.

-willing to work on a project based set up. the faster you finish a project the more projects to be given and higher chance of earning more. 



Nice to Have



-Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, or Final Cut Pro.

-Understanding of marketing or storytelling in lifestyle, beauty, or creative industries.

-Familiarity with the Hawaii market or island culture.



Why You’ll Love Working With Us



-Hawaii-based creative energy (we like chill, but we mean business).

-Flexible working schedule with long-term potential.

-Collaborative team that values passion and initiative.

title: Remote Legal Admin – Australian Claims
description:
Important: Read This Before Applying



There are strict instructions on how to apply for this position. If you do not follow the instructions exactly, your application may be marked as spam and you may not be contacted.



Your application must include all of the following:



1. Your latest resume.

2. A covering letter explaining why you believe you are suitable for this role.

3. An original Loom video answering the application question at the bottom of this post.



The Loom video must be recorded specifically for this application. Do not send a generic Loom that you have used for other jobs. Do not copy a script or read from a template.



We want to hear how you naturally communicate in English and assess your ability to explain information clearly and professionally.



If your application is missing anything, or if your Loom appears copied, scripted, AI-generated, old or generic, you may not be considered.



About The Role



TPD Matters is looking for a reliable, highly organised and detail-focused Remote Legal Admin to join our Australian legal support team.



We assist clients with Total and Permanent Disability (TPD) claims. Many of our clients are dealing with injuries, illnesses and difficult personal circumstances, so professionalism, confidentiality, accuracy and clear communication are extremely important. This is a hands-on administrative and legal support role focused on helping client files progress efficiently.



You will maintain client files, manage documents and correspondence, complete follow-ups, communicate with clients and external organisations, and ensure tasks are properly recorded and actioned. This role requires someone who takes ownership of their work. You must be able to identify what needs to be done, follow established processes, complete tasks accurately and report back clearly.



What You Will Be Doing



Your responsibilities may include:

- Updating and maintaining client files, records, notes, tasks and follow-ups.

- Assisting with the progression of client matters through the required administrative stages.

- Managing incoming documents, correspondence and client information accurately.

- Saving
s, documents and correspondence to the correct client file.

- Ensuring important correspondence is actioned rather than simply received or filed.

- Creating and updating tasks, reminders and next steps so that required actions are not missed.

- Contacting clients to obtain information, documents, signatures or updates when required.

- Contacting superannuation funds, insurers and other relevant organisations to request information and follow up outstanding matters.

- Following up outstanding requests consistently and escalating delays or issues when appropriate.

- Preparing, sending and following up documents and forms as directed.

- Maintaining accurate and detailed file notes after calls,
s and other actions.

- Working within Actionstep and other CRM/client management systems.

- Communicating clearly with the Sydney team and remote team.

- Following SOPs, checklists, training materials and written instructions.

- Reporting clearly on completed work, outstanding tasks, blockers and matters requiring escalation.

- Handling confidential and sensitive client information carefully and professionally.

- Assisting with other legal administration and file-management tasks as directed.



Performance Expectations

This is a detail-focused and accountability-driven role.



Your success will be measured by the quality and accuracy of your work, your ability to progress tasks efficiently, follow-up consistency, file and CRM accuracy, communication, responsiveness and your ability to follow established processes.



We expect you to:

- Complete assigned tasks accurately and within required timeframes.

- Keep client files, notes, documents and tasks organised and up to date.

- Follow up outstanding matters without needing repeated reminders.

- Record actions clearly so another tea
mber can immediately understand what has occurred and what needs to happen next.

- Properly action incoming
s and correspondence rather than leaving them unattended.

- Escalate problems, delays or uncertainty instead of allowing a matter to sit unresolved.

- Be available and responsive during working hours.

- Communicate clearly when a task is completed, delayed or requires assistance.

- Follow SOPs and instructions consistently.



Accuracy is extremely important. Our team works with legal matters and sensitive client information, so incomplete notes, missed follow-ups, incorrectly saved documents or unactioned correspondence can affect the progression of a client’s matter.



Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

- Has excellent written and good spoken English.

- Can comfortably work with CRM systems, client files, folders, documents and task lists.

- Is highly organised, reliable and detail-focused.

- Communicates professionally and naturally with Australian clients and stakeholders.

- Has strong administrative skills and can manage multiple files, tasks and follow-ups without losing track of important actions.

- Takes ownership of assigned work and follows tasks through to completion.

- Is confident making professional outbound calls when follow-up is required.

- Is comfortable communicating with clients, insurers, superannuation funds and other organisations.

- Availability to work Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm (AEST/AEDT) Sydney time, unless otherwise agreed.

- Can work independently while still reporting back clearly to the team.

- Is responsive and reliable during working hours.

- Understands the importance of confidentiality when handling sensitive client and legal information.

- Is willing to learn and adapt to Australian legal and administrative processes.

- Experience That Will Be Highly Regarded



Experience in any of the following will be viewed favourably:

- Legal administration.

- Legal assistant or legal clerk work.

- CRM or case-management systems.

- Claims administration or claims support.

- Insurance administration.

- Personal injury or disability claims.

- Client services.

- Australian legal, insurance or professional services businesses.

- Document-heavy administrative roles.

- Roles involving regular client and stakeholder follow-up.



Previous experience with Actionstep is an advantage but is not required. We are more interested in your ability to learn systems quickly, follow processes accurately and maintain high-quality records.



What We Offer

- Full-time remote work with a growing Australian business.

- A structured role with clear SOPs, training and support.

- Training in our systems and processes.

- A stable long-term opportunity for the right person.

- Meaningful work supporting clients who may be going through difficult circumstances.

- Weekly payment in arrears through Wise after onboarding.

- Two weeks of prorated paid time off during the Christmas closedown period.

- Selected Australian public holidays recognised in line with company policy.

- Opportunity to develop strong experience in Australian legal administration and claims processes.

- Long-term opportunity for someone who performs well, communicates clearly and consistently follows the process.

- Application Question For Your Loom Video



Record a short Loom video answering the following scenario:



"Imagine you are assisting with an Australian client’s legal matter. You notice that information requested from an external organisation has still not been received, and the client is also waiting for an update.

Talk us through what you would do next and explain how you would communicate with the client, the external organisation and your internal team."



Please answer naturally, in your own words. Do not read from a script, copy an answer from the internet or use a template.



Final Instruction

To show that you have read the full advert, start the first line of your application with this exact phrase:



TPD Matters Admin



If you do not include this exact phrase at the start of your application, your application may be marked as spam and you may not be contacted.

title: AI Backend Engineer / AI Integration Engineer (Remote)
description:
Fully Remote | Full-time



We are looking for a strong Backend Engineer who is comfortable working with Linux, servers, APIs, and open-source software, and who is highly interested in the fast-moving generative AI ecosystem.



You do not need to be a machine learning researcher, and you do not need years of previous AI experience.



What matters more is that you are a strong engineer who can quickly understand unfamiliar open-source projects, get them running, troubleshoot problems independently, and turn new technologies into usable product features.



What We’re Looking For?

3+ years of professional development experience with at least one backend programming language, such as Python, PHP, Java, Node.js, Ruby, Go, or similar.

Strong backend development experience, preferably with Python.

Very comfortable working with Linux and command-line environments.

Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

Familiar with Git, Docker, Python environments, APIs, server deployment, and dependency management.

Able to independently deploy and maintain services on Linux servers.

Comfortable reading GitHub repositories, technical documentation, issues, discussions, and source code.

Able to quickly understand unfamiliar open-source projects and make them work.

Strong ability to troubleshoot environment, dependency, GPU, CUDA, memory, and deployment issues.

Highly proactive and self-driven.

Strong interest in generative AI and open-source technologies.

Willing to continuously experiment with new tools, models, and workflows.

Comfortable working remotely with strong self-management and online communication skills.



We value practical engineering ability, curiosity, and learning speed more than formal AI or machine learning credentials.



What You’ll Do?

Build, modify, debug, and optimize ComfyUI workflows.

Research newly released open-source image, video, audio, and multimodal generation models.

Quickly test promising models and understand their actual capabilities, limitations, hardware requirements, and potential product use cases.

Deploy open-source models on GPU servers.

Integrate useful models and workflows into our apps, websites, and backend services.

Build APIs and backend services around AI generation pipelines.

Research different LoRA training tools and training workflows.

Run LoRA training experiments and tune training configurations to improve results.

Compare different models, checkpoints, LoRAs, workflows, and inference configurations.

Optimize generation speed, GPU memory usage, stability, and output quality.

Continuously follow GitHub, Hugging Face, 
, Reddit, X, YouTube, and other AI communities to discover useful new models and tools as early as possible.

Nice to Have



Previous experience in the following areas is helpful, but not required:



ComfyUI

Hugging Face models

Image or video generation models

LoRA training

PyTorch

CUDA and GPU environments

RunPod, Vast.ai, AWS, or other GPU cloud platforms

Stable Diffusion, FLUX, Qwen Image, Wan, or similar open-source models

musubi-tuner, AI Toolkit, kohya_ss, or similar training tools

The Kind of Person We Want



The generative AI ecosystem changes extremely quickly.



We are looking for someone who enjoys exploring new technologies and can learn through documentation, source code, community discussions, and experimentation.



When a useful open-source model is released, you should be able to quickly:



Find it.

Deploy it.

Test it.

Understand what it can and cannot do.

Modify or optimize the workflow.

Determine whether it is useful for our products.

Integrate it into production if it provides value.



You do not need to invent new AI models from scratch.



Your job is to stay close to the open-source AI ecosystem and turn the best available technologies into real product capabilities as quickly as possible.



Comfortable working remotely with strong self-management and online communication skills.
