title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
LEAD GENERATION SPECIALIST (Remote, Philippines)



San Miguel Painting is a family owned residential painting company in the Dallas-Fort Worth area of Texas, and we are on a mission to become the best painting brand in Texas. We are not just filling a seat. We are looking for someone who wants a career, a team to grow with, and a place to become truly great at what they do.



WORK SCHEDULE

Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central Time, USA. Please note this is a US daytime schedule, which falls during the evening and overnight hours in the Philippines. Only apply if you can commit to these hours long term.



COMPENSATION

$620 per month base (approximately $3.58 per hour, full time), plus performance rewards. You earn 50 cents for every appointment you set, and 10 dollars for every project won and paid, meaning the client signs and pays their deposit from an appointment you booked. The harder you work and the better you get, the more you earn. Top performers earn well above the base.



ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a phone specialist role and the engine of our growth. You are the first voice a future client hears, and you turn interest into booked proposals while making every caller feel taken care of from the very first hello. You keep our calendar full, you move fast on new leads, and you follow up until the job is booked. Our motto is Crafting Excellence Beyond the Brush, and that excellence starts on your call.



If you want to clock in, do the bare minimum, and clock out, this is not the place for you. If you want to be part of an elite team that pushes each other, celebrates wins together, and grows every single week, keep reading. We build like a family, and we win like one.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Speed to Lead: Respond to and call new leads fast. The quicker we reach them, the more we book.

- Inbound Call Management: Answer incoming calls with warmth and confidence, qualify the caller, and book them for a proposal.

- Outbound Calls and Lead Generation: Reach out and follow up with new leads to book and rebook appointments and keep new business coming in.

- Keep the Calendar Booked: Fill our sales calendar, confirm every appointment, and reduce no shows with reminders.

- High Quality Conversations: Serve the client first. Real conversations book more jobs than rushed ones.

- Post Proposal Follow Up: After a proposal is sent, follow up with clients to help book and close, especially when our sales rep cannot get to everyone.

- Pipeline Hygiene: Keep every lead accurate and up to date in PaintScout so nothing falls through the cracks.

- Go Above and Beyond: Own your lane fully. Spot ways to book more and improve the caller experience, and bring those ideas to the table.



PERFORMANCE TARGETS (YOUR SCORECARD)

These break into two groups. The Daily Non-Negotiables are fully in your hands, and we expect them every day. The Goals We Chase Together are the outcomes we drive toward as a team, coach you on, and celebrate when you hit them.



Daily Non-Negotiables, fully in your control:

- 75 to 100 plus calls per day.

- Speed to lead: first call attempt within 3 minutes or less of a new lead during business hours.

- Follow up at least 12 times across call, text, and
 before setting a lead aside, and even more persistently on paid leads. We paid to earn that conversation, so we do not give up on it. Most appointments come after the fourth touch.

- Log and update every lead in PaintScout the same day.



Goals We Chase Together, we coach and aim for these:

- Book 10 to 12 qualified appointments every week. This is our north star.

- Show rate: aim for 80 percent or more of your booked appointments to show up and have their proposal run. A booking truly counts when the client shows.

- Aim for at least 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes of talk time per day, growing as you sharpen your craft. Some days run slower than others, and that is okay. Effort and quality come first.



THE MINDSET WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Coachable: Eager to learn our scripts and get better every week.

- Open Mindset: You welcome feedback and new ideas.

- Brings Energy: You show up ready, positive, and hard to rattle.

- Client First: You genuinely want to serve people, not just hit a number.



QUALIFICATIONS

- Spoken English: Clear, warm, and confident spoken English is required. This is a phone role with US clients, so strong phone communication is the single most important qualification.

- Experience: Prior appointment setting, lead generation, sales support, customer service, or call center experience preferred, ideally for a US based business.

- Drive: You are motivated by hitting goals and earning more when you perform.

- Reliability: Highly dependable and consistent, with a strong commitment to showing up and following through.

- Tech Comfort: Comfortable learning CRM and scheduling software. Experience with PaintScout or similar is a plus.

- Home Office: A quiet, uninterrupted workspace, a reliable computer, a good headset, and a stable internet connection suitable for daily calls.



WHY JOIN SAN MIGUEL PAINTING

- We Are a Family: We live by our core values every single day: Collaboration, Responsibility, Service, Quality, and Integrity. When you win, we all win.

- Build a Career, Not Just a Job: We invest in our people. As we grow, you grow. Strong performers move up and take on more.

- Be Part of an Elite Team: We hold a high standard and we push each other to improve, scale, and grow together. You will be surrounded by people who want to be great.

- Your Voice Matters: We want your ideas. The best people here step up, speak up, and help us get better every day.

- A Long Term Home: We are looking for someone to build with us for years, not weeks.



TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word BRUSH so we know you read this posting all the way through.

2. Send your resume and a short note on why you want to grow with a team like ours.

3. Attach a 60 second voice recording where you introduce yourself and pretend you are calling a homeowner to book a painting proposal. We want to hear your phone voice.



We look forward to welcoming a new member to our family.

**Primary System:** Oracle NetSuite



## Position Overview



We are looking for a **Senior Accountant / Accounting Operations Manager** to support and help build a structured accounting operation for a growing organization.



The ideal candidate has strong accounting knowledge, hands-on **Oracle NetSuite** experience, management or team-lead experience, and a strong understanding of modern online tools and AI.



This position will play an important role in managing accounting operations, supporting AP and AR functions, working with vendors and customers, training accounting tea
mbers, and developing processes and documentation for a growing remote accounting team.



## Key Responsibilities



### Accounting Operations



* Manage day-to-day accounting activities and ensure transactions are accurately recorded.

* Perform and review journal entries, reconciliations, and financial reports.

* Assist with month-end and year-end closing.

* Maintain accurate and organized accounting records.

* Identify and resolve accounting discrepancies.

* Ensure accounting procedures and internal controls are followed.



### Oracle NetSuite



* Work extensively within **Oracle NetSuite** for accounting and financial operations.

* Maintain and review customer, vendor, and financial records.

* Process and review accounting transactions within NetSuite.

* Help improve NetSuite workflows and accounting processes.

* Support tea
mbers with NetSuite-related questions and processes.

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting tasks.



### Accounts Payable



* Oversee vendor invoices and payment processing.

* Maintain accurate vendor records.

* Review invoices for proper coding, approval, and documentation.

* Monitor outstanding payables and payment schedules.

* Resolve vendor billing discrepancies.

* Help establish standardized AP procedures.



### Accounts Receivable



* Oversee customer invoicing and receivables activities.

* Maintain accurate customer records.

* Monitor outstanding balances and overdue accounts.

* Reconcile customer accounts and resolve discrepancies.

* Assist with collections and customer billing issues.

* Establish standardized AR procedures and reporting.



### Vendor & Customer Management



* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of vendors and customers.

* Understand vendor-specific and customer-specific accounting requirements.

* Maintain accurate documentation for important vendor and customer processes.

* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve accounting-related issues.

* Ensure important accounting communications are properly documented and escalated.



### Team Management & Training



* Support and manage a remote accounting team.

* Train new accounting employees on accounting procedures, systems, and workflows.

* Develop SOPs, checklists, and training documentation.

* Establish clear responsibilities across accounting functions.

* Review team performance and accounting accuracy.

* Provide guidance on complex accounting issues.

* Help create a repeatable onboarding and training process.



### Automation & AI



* Identify repetitive accounting tasks that can be improved through automation.

* Use AI tools to improve productivity, documentation, research, and workflows.

* Look for opportunities to automate reporting, data entry, communications, and other repetitive tasks.

* Work with management to implement practical automation solutions.

* Stay familiar with modern accounting technology and AI tools.



## Team Structure



The accounting operation may include specialized responsibilities such as:



* **Controller** – Overall accounting leadership, financial oversight, and controls.

* **NetSuite Accounting Specialist** – NetSuite-related accounting operations and system processes.

* **Accounts Payable Specialist** – Vendor invoices, payables, and payment processing.

* **Accounts Receivable Specialist** – Customer billing, receivables, collections, and reconciliation.



The Senior Accountant / Accounting Operations Manager will help establish the processes, documentation, and workflows that allow these functions to operate efficiently.



## Training & Documentation



A key responsibility of this position will be helping establish formal training and documentation for the accounting team.



The candidate will help create:



* Accounting SOPs.

* NetSuite process documentation.

* Vendor-specific procedures.

* Customer-specific procedures.

* AP and AR checklists.

* New employee training materials.

* Recurring accounting task documentation.

* Escalation procedures.

* Internal accounting knowledge resources.



The goal is to create a system where new accounting employees can be trained efficiently without relying solely on informal or undocumented knowledge.



## Communication



The candidate will communicate regularly with management, accounting tea
mbers, vendors, customers, and other internal departments.



Strong written and verbal English communication skills are required.



## Requirements



* **3–5+ years of professional accounting experience.**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

* Experience in a senior accountant, accounting lead, supervisor, or management-level position.

* Hands-on experience with **Oracle NetSuite**.

* Strong understanding of general accounting principles.

* Experience with Accounts Payable and/or Accounts Receivable.

* Experience with account reconciliations and month-end close.

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication.

* Strong organizational and documentation skills.

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

* Comfortable working with online business tools and digital systems.

* Ability to work effectively with management, vendors, customers, and accounting tea
mbers.



### Preferred Qualifications



* Experience managing or supervising accounting employees.

* Experience working with U.S.-based accounting processes.

* Advanced Oracle NetSuite experience.

* Experience creating accounting SOPs and training programs.

* Experience working with remote or distributed teams.

* Experience with accounting automation.

* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT.

* CPA, CMA, or equivalent certification is a plus.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is more than a transactional accountant. We are looking for someone who can **take ownership of accounting operations, manage people and processes, work confidently in NetSuite, and help build a scalable accounting system.**



The successful candidate should be:



* Detail-oriented and highly organized.

* Comfortable taking initiative.

* Strong at problem-solving.

* Comfortable managing or mentoring tea
mbers.

* Able to quickly learn new systems and processes.

* Comfortable working with vendors and customers.

* Interested in improving processes through technology and automation.

* Able to create clear documentation and training materials.

* Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.



## Key Performance Indicators



Success in this role will be measured by:



* Accounting accuracy.

* Timeliness of month-end close.

* AP and AR processing accuracy.

* Reconciliation accuracy.

* NetSuite data accuracy.

* Vendor and customer issue resolution.

* Completion and quality of accounting SOPs.

* Training and onboarding effectiveness.

* Team productivity.

* Reduction of repetitive manual accounting work through automation.

This is not simply a development or “deploy our website” role.



We need someone who has **deep practical experience with Netlify and 
**, understands how these platforms operate under the hood, and can advise us on the correct architecture, configuration and deployment strategy based on best practice.

 architecture and configuration

Where relevant, experience with **Cloudflare, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions and similar cloud infrastructure technologies** would also be valuable.

 for everything.

 is excellent at

 are currently being used.

## Required Experience

* 

* Modern cloud infrastructure

You should also have a strong understanding of modern frontend/backend architecture and be able to determine **which workloads belong on which platform**.



## What We Are NOT Looking For



We are not looking for:



* A general web developer who has used Netlify once or twice

We are specifically looking for someone with **platform-level expertise and strong infrastructure judgement**.



## When Applying

?**

?**

.**

Please provide specific examples rather than general statements.

title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer — AI + High CTR
description:
The Beverly Halls is looking for a talented full-time YouTube Thumbnail Designer to join our growing production team.



We are an established family entertainment channel with millions of followers across social media. We are building a dedicated post-production team and are looking for someone who understands that a great YouTube thumbnail is not simply a beautiful graphic — its job is to make someone want to click.



This position is specifically for someone who understands YouTube thumbnails, CTR, visual storytelling and entertainment content.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Create multiple thumbnail concepts for long-form YouTube uploads

• Turn raw photos, screenshots and video frames into compelling thumbnail compositions

• Create clear visual stories that can be understood instantly

• Design strong facial-expression and reaction-based thumbnails when appropriate

• Create clean subject cutouts, realistic compositing, lighting adjustments and retouching

• Understand hierarchy, contrast, scale and mobile readability

• Produce alternate thumbnail versions for testing

• Help refresh thumbnails on existing videos when needed

• Work with our editors and production team to identify the strongest 
nts/images from each video

• Maintain organized Photoshop/source files and reusable channel assets



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



• Proven experience creating YouTube thumbnails

• Strong understanding of click-through rate (CTR) and what makes viewers click

• Excellent Photoshop or equivalent image-editing skills

• Strong photo manipulation and compositing ability

• Ability to create exciting thumbnails without making them look cheap or overly cluttered

• Understanding of American YouTube entertainment/family content

• Excellent English comprehension

• Fast turnaround and strong communication

• Comfortable receiving feedback and quickly creating alternate concepts



IMPORTANT:



We are NOT looking for someone who primarily designs logos, flyers, social-media posts or corporate graphics.



We are specifically looking for a YouTube thumbnail specialist.



TO APPLY



Please send us 5–10 of the BEST YouTube thumbnails you have personally created.



If possible, include links to the actual YouTube videos where those thumbnails were used.



Please answer:



Which YouTube channels do you believe have the best thumbnails and why?

We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-ter
mber of our production team.

title: Finance & Cashflow Manager
description:
Finance & Cash Flow Manager — Remote, Part-Time

E-Commerce · Subscription Business · DTC Brand



We run a growing direct-to-consumer brand with a subscription model. We spend six figures a month on paid advertising across Meta and operate multiple stores. We need someone detail-oriented, reliable, and comfortable with numbers to own our day-to-day financial tracking.



This is a numbers-first role. You tell us exactly where we stand — not just at month end, but daily.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Daily Finance Tracking

Log daily ad spend per store (Meta), record daily orders and revenue, track front-end sales vs subscription rebill revenue separately, calculate daily CPA, and flag any day where CPA exceeds agreed thresholds.



Subscription Rebill Tracking

Track biweekly subscription billing cycles per customer cohort, log which bill number each cohort is on, record actual subscription revenue vs projected, and track approval rates on each billing attempt.



Cost of Goods & Order Management

Track COG per order across stores, ensure COG invoices are paid on schedule, and flag any discrepancy between orders and COG invoiced.



Customer Service Coordination (light)

Work with our CS team to stay on top of refund volumes and compile a simple weekly summary of refunds and chargebacks. Basic awareness of processing fees helpful.



Cash Flow & Bank Balance

Maintain a live business bank account balance tracker updated daily. Track payout timing from our payment processor and flag immediately if the balance is getting tight.



Reporting

Weekly P&L summary every Monday. Monthly profit report broken down by store. Maintain the master Google Sheet tracker.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Must have:



Strong Google Sheets skills — formulas, formatting, comfortable building trackers from scratch

Experience tracking finances for an e-commerce or similar business

Understanding of subscription billing and recurring revenue

Works independently with minimal supervision

Available daily to log and update numbers

Responds within a few hours during business hours

Fluent English — clear written communication



Nice to have:



Experience with Shopify or similar platforms

Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager

Previous work with subscription, dropshipping, or e-commerce businesses



KEY METRICS YOU WILL OWN



Daily CPA · Bank balance · Refund rate · Chargeback rate · COG payments



Numbers must be updated daily. Accuracy is everything.



WHAT THIS IS NOT



Not a bookkeeping or accounting role. Not a one-hour-a-week job — this requires daily attention. Not a passive role — we need someone who flags issues before they become problems.



PAY



We are very open on pay. Quality is what matters to us — if you are genuinely good at this, the compensation will reflect it.



HOW TO APPLY



Send a short message covering:



Your experience tracking finances for an e-commerce or subscription business

A specific example of a cash flow or tracking problem you caught and resolved

Your Google Sheets skills — be specific about what you have built

Your hourly or monthly rate

Your daily availability and timezone



To confirm you have read this post, start your application with #subscriptionjewels — applications without this will not be considered.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a 
nt to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 50 wp
ans you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 10 – August 20

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: |

IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:

)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.

Ethan

This is a **fast-paced, customer-facing role** for someone who genuinely enjoys sales, communication, problem-solving, and building strong client relationships.

We are looking for someone who wants **long-term growth, stability, and the opportunity to take on more responsibility as the company grows** — not someone looking for a temporary position.



## ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll communicate with U.S.-based leads and clients throughout the day, guide prospects through the sales process, coordinate with our operations team, and help ensure customers have an excellent experience from their first interaction through ongoing service.



The ideal candidate is someone who is **responsive, confident, organized, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership**. You should be able to work independently, stay focused in a fast-paced environment, and consistently follow through without needing to be reminded.



## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



* Answer incoming calls, texts, and
s from leads and clients

* Coordinate with the scheduling and operations teams

* Assist with customer questions, concerns, and problem-solving

* Identify opportunities to improve lead conversion and sales performance

* Follow established processes while also identifying ways to make them better

* Assist with administrative and organizational tasks as needed

Success in this role is measurable. We expect you to:



* Respond to leads and clients quickly

* Follow up consistently and professionally

* Take ownership of leads from initial inquiry through the sales process

* Focus on converting leads into paying and recurring clients

* Meet established sales and performance goals

* Maintain accurate CRM records and follow company processes

* Multitask effectively without sacrificing quality

* Stay calm, organized, and solution-focused under pressure

* Take initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do



## WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



### Required



* **Fluent English (spoken and written)** — you must be confident communicating with U.S.-based clients in real time

* Excellent communication and customer service skills

* Strong sales and follow-up abilities

* Highly organized with strong attention to detail

* Ability to make decisions quickly and use good judgment

* Ability to manage multiple conversations, leads, and tasks simultaneously

* Strong problem-solving skills

* **Ownership mindset** — when you encounter a problem, you take responsibility for seeing it through to resolution

* Self-starter with a proactive, positive attitude

* Reliable and consistent work history

* Intermediate computer and Excel skills

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment



### Strong Plus



* Spanish-speaking ability

* Previous experience in sales, customer service, scheduling, or operations

* Experience working with a CRM

* Experience with **Maid Central, GoHighLevel, or similar platforms**

* Experience in the cleaning, home services, or other service-based industries



## TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



To succeed in this remote position, you must have:



* Reliable high-speed internet

* A reliable laptop or desktop computer

* Working camera and headset

* Quiet, professional, distraction-free workspace



## COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



* Compensation based on experience

* Performance-based growth opportunities

* Paid onboarding and training

* **Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM–5:30 PM Central Time (U.S.)**

* U.S. holidays observed

* Paid time off

* Opportunity for advancement and increased responsibility

* Long-term opportunity with a growing company



## WHY JOIN NOT JUST DUST?



At Not Just Dust, you won't simply be answering calls or managing leads. **Your work will directly contribute to the growth of the company and the experience our customers receive.**



You'll have the opportunity to:



* Work with a fast-moving and growing team

* Develop your sales, communication, and leadership skills

* Take on greater responsibility as you grow with the company

title: Senior Recruiter - US Healthcare (Imaging/Allied) - Night Shift, Remote
description:
US-based direct-hire healthcare recruiting firm is hiring a Senior Recruiter (full-cycle, voice) for our imaging/allied and physician desks. We hand you pre-sourced, pre-verified candidate worklists every shift (our AI engine builds the pools — sourcing is NOT your bottleneck). You get US healthcare candidates on the PHONE, screen them properly, verify their credentials, write a submit-ready candidate packet, and book the submission with our US team. All candidates you recruit are US-based clinicians (radiologic technologists, CT/MRI techs, sonographers, surgical techs, respiratory therapists, physicians); all clients are US hospitals and health systems. Fully remote, Philippines-based, long-term.



This is a senior seat with a real quota and real commission: you own the screened-submission number for your desk, starting at 5 screened submissions/week and ramping to 10. Every placement you make pays you a commission on top of base.



WHAT YOU DO DAILY:

- Work the AI-generated worklist: call US imaging/allied and physician candidates (we provide the phone system; allied-health candidates prefer phone — that's why this is a voice seat).

- Run a structured recruiter screen: motivation, compensation expectations, licensure, timeline, fit against the live req.

- Verify credentials before any submission (ARRT, ARDMS/RDMS/RDCS/RVT, CST, CRCST, RRT, state licenses — our screen-and-credential gate; nothing unverified goes to a client).

- Write a tight, submit-ready candidate packet (summary, credentials, comp, availability, why-this-req) and book the client submission with the US team.

- Keep the ATS honest: every call, every disposition, same day.



REQUIRED:

- 3+ years US healthcare AGENCY recruiting (imaging/allied, nursing, or physician desks — agency/staffing side, not internal HR). Imaging/allied depth is a strong plus: you should know what ARRT, RDMS, or CST mean without looking them up.

- Proven PERSONAL production numbers you can state and defend — your own submissions, interviews, and placements for a recent quarter (not your team's). We verify on the interview.

- You have personally phone-screened US candidates end-to-end — this is not a sourcing-only or
-only seat.

- Excellent spoken English for US phone screens — clear, confident, professional. This is the #1 requirement and there WILL be a live spoken check.

- Can work the FIXED US night shift long-term (9:00 PM-6:00 AM PHT, Mon-Fri) with a reliable home setup (quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data).

- Disciplined ATS usage — honest pipeline reporting, no ghost activity.



COMPENSATION: $1,000-$1,300/month base (by experience and proven production; night differential included) + monthly performance commission on every placement you close — commission specifics discussed at offer. Paid via Wise, reliable and on time.



DO NOT APPLY IF: you have never recruited for US healthcare accounts; your experience is sourcing/research only and you've never personally phone-screened and submitted a candidate; you can't state your own submission/interview/placement numbers; your spoken English isn't strong enough for live US candidate calls; you can't commit to the fixed US night shift; or your only healthcare exposure is BPO customer service / claims processing (this is a recruiting seat, not a support seat).



WHY US: the sourcing grind is already done for you — our AI engine hands you verified candidate pools every day, so your time goes to the high-value work (screening, closing candidates, placements = commission). Competitive base at the top of the market, fully remote, long-term, with a clear path Senior Recruiter ? Desk Lead as the team grows.



TO APPLY, ANSWER ALL SIX (applications missing any of these will not be reviewed):

title: Law Firm Business Development & Growth Manager
description:
Job description:



Our Law Firm is a California law firm handling business and corporate transactional work, i.e., entity formations, governance, contracts and commercial agreements, compliance counseling, negotiations, and sports- and entertainment-related business matters, alongside a personal injury practice. We are hiring one person to build and run the firm's client-development engine.



This is not a social-media coordinator role. You will own marketing and business development end to end: where qualified work comes from, which channels deserve investment, how leads are tracked, and how inquiries become consultations. If you want a role where your judgment shows up directly in the firm's growth, this is it. If you want a marketing department around you, it isn't.



About the Opportunity



Small firm, large surface area. You will work directly with the firm's owner and build systems rather than inherit them. There is no legacy marketing infrastructure to defend and no committee between you and a decision. What you build here, you will be able to point to for the rest of your career.



Because this is a law firm, growth happens inside professional-responsibility rules. Advertising, outreach, and intake run through attorney-approved systems and remain subject to attorney supervision. You will never be asked to give legal advice, evaluate a matter, or d
 whether the firm accepts a representation, the attorneys do that. Within those boundaries, you have real latitude to test, build, and d
.



What You'll Own



Client-acquisition strategy — identify where qualified business realistically comes from for both practice areas, then build the channels to reach it

Referral and partnership development — cultivate professional referral relationships, strategic partnerships, associations, conferences, and sponsorships appropriate for a law firm

Lead generation and funnels — landing pages, offers, calls to action, and disciplined channel testing

CRM and pipeline — MyCase workflows, lead attribution, source tracking, and clean data you can actually trust

Intake support — strengthen attorney-approved intake and nurture processes so qualified inquiries reach a consultation instead of going cold

Digital — organic search and content strategy,
 campaigns and nurture sequences, social media strategy, and Google/Meta advertising where the economics justify it

Website and collateral — coordinate site improvements; produce professional materials in Canva or comparable tools

Measurement — KPIs and attribution; cost per lead, qualified-lead rate, consultation rate, conversion rate, and spend efficiency; weekly or monthly growth reporting

Systemization — document what works so successful acquisition methods become repeatable

Initiative — bring the firm growth experiments rather than waiting to be handed a plan

What We're Looking For



Required / Core Qualifications



Roughly three or more years in legal marketing, law firm business development, professional-services growth, intake optimization, or a comparable revenue-development role

Client-acquisition work you personally built or materially operated — not work you supported from the edges

Hands-on CRM implementation and pipeline management

Working command of paid acquisition, SEO and content,
, analytics, and conversion optimization

Comfort being accountable to measurable results, and the judgment to tell activity apart from results

Understanding that legal-industry marketing operates within professional-responsibility constraints, and the discipline to work inside them

California-based and authorized to work in the United States

Strongly Preferred



Law firm or professional-services experience

Transactional and business-law marketing: formations, corporate work, contracts, partnerships, governance, compliance, commercial transactions

Personal injury marketing or intake experience

Business-development background, relationships, or demonstrated success in sports, athletics, athlete representation ecosystems, entertainment, or media

MyCase — not required if you have run other CRMs and learn new systems quickly

What Success Looks Like



Success is measured by what you can genuinely influence: qualified leads generated, pipeline created, new referral and source channels developed, CRM discipline, quality campaigns that convert potential clients, into clients, improvement in conversion from qualified inquiry to attorney consultation, lead quality, cost efficiency, and marketing ROI where it can be measured reliably. We are not asking anyone to guarantee outcomes. We are asking for systems whose results can be seen and repeated.



Compensation



Pay incentives tied to marketing and business-development metrics — qualified lead generation, consultation volume, campaign and channel performance, and contribution to overall firm growth. Consistent with California professional-responsibility rules, incentive compensation is not tied to fees, settlements, or recoveries from any particular client or matter.



Incentive terms will be provided to you in writing. The firm provides or reimburses the equipment, software, and services reasonably and approved by firm as required to do the job, as California law requires.



Location & Work Arrangement



Although the firm is based in California, you are not required to be a California-based professional. However, you will need availability during California business hours when the work reasonably requires it, a professional remote-work environment, and reliable connectivity. The firm operates virtually but meets clients in person on request, so occasional in-person meetings or industry events in Southern California may come up (at this time you will not be expected to attend those in-person meetings/events).



How to Apply



Apply here with your résumé and brief answers to the application questions. We are looking for specifics, not polish. Please be prepared to tell us:



Your law firm or professional-services business-development experience

Two or three campaigns, funnels, referral channels, or systems you personally built or materially operated

Measurable results from that work, where you can lawfully share them

The tools, CRMs, and advertising platforms you have personally used

Your experience, if any, with transactional legal services

Your experience, if any, with personal injury

Your experience, relationships, or business-development background, if any, in sports or entertainment

Your answer to this: If you joined a small California law firm tomorrow and were responsible for building its client-development engine, what would you evaluate during your first 30 days?

Do not include confidential, privileged, proprietary, or former-client information in your examples. Describe the work generally and share figures only where you can do so lawfully.



Are You Ready To Join The Team



We are hiring one person for this. We would rather wait for someone who can both think and execute than fill the seat quickly. If that is you, your 30-day answer will tell us more than your résumé will.



Benefits:





Flexible schedule

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply



Application Question(s):





How many years have you worked in legal marketing, law firm business development, or professional-services revenue development?

Describe one client-acquisition system, funnel, or referral channel you personally built. What did it produce?

Which CRMs and advertising platforms have you personally used, and in what capacity?

Do you have experience marketing transactional/business legal services? Describe briefly.

Do you have experience with personal injury marketing or intake? Describe briefly.

Do you have business-development experience or relationships in sports, athletics, entertainment, or media?

If you joined a small California law firm tomorrow and were responsible for building its client-development engine, what would you evaluate during your first 30 days?

Are authorized to work in the United States; and where are you based?

title: Legal Case Manager – U.S. Employment Law Firm | Part-Time Trial ? Long-Term
description:
# Experienced Legal Case Manager / Legal Assistant – U.S. Law Firm



Growing U.S. employment law firm is seeking an **experienced Legal Case Manager / Legal Assistant** for a long-term remote position.



**This is not an entry-level position. Prior legal case-management or substantive law-firm experience is required.**



We are looking for someone who already understands how to manage legal work, communicate professionally with clients, organize case files, track deadlines and outstanding items, follow up without repeated reminders, and keep matters moving.



The position will begin at approximately **10–20 hours per week**, but we have substantial work available. A strong performer who consistently completes accurate work, meets deadlines and demonstrates initiative may receive significantly more hours.



### Compensation



* **$2.50 USD/hour starting rate**

* Approximately **10–20 hours per week to start**

* Additional hours available based on performance and workload

* Potential for substantial part-time or full-time hours for an exceptional performer

* Compensation may be reviewed as the firm grows and responsibilities increase

* Strong performers may become eligible for discretionary performance bonuses

* Long-term opportunity



### What You Should Already Know How to Do



You should be comfortable independently handling many of the following:



* Client intake and follow-up

* Professional client telephone and
 communication

* Organizing and maintaining legal case files

* Tracking deadlines, tasks and outstanding documents

* Maintaining a legal case-management system

* Preparing factual chronologies and timelines

* Reviewing and summarizing records

* Obtaining missing information and documents from clients

* Following up persistently and professionally

* Conducting legal and factual research

* Assisting with correspondence and legal documents

* Preparing files for attorney review

* Identifying missing information, inconsistencies and overdue tasks

* Managing multiple matters and competing priorities



Experience with **MyCase, Clio, Filevine, CasePeer, Lawmatics or similar legal case-management software** is strongly preferred.



Experience in **U.S. employment law, personal injury, workers' compensation, litigation, disability, immigration, or another client-intensive legal practice** is particularly valuable.



### What We Are Looking For



We need someone who can **take work off the attorney's plate rather than create additional work.**



You should be:



* Experienced in legal support or case management

* Highly organized

* Productive

* Proactive

* Reliable

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable communicating with U.S. clients

* Able to work independently

* Able to recognize when something is missing or requires follow-up

* Comfortable managing multiple active matters



You will, of course, receive instructions about **our firm's cases, procedures and systems**, but we are **not looking to teach someone the fundamentals of legal case management.**



Availability during **U.S. Eastern Time business hours** is required.



### How to Apply



Start your message with: **CASE MANAGER**, attach a current resume, and briefly answer:



1. How long have you worked for law firms, and what types of cases did you handle?

2. What case-management responsibilities did you personally perform?

3. What legal case-management software have you used?

4. What U.S. Eastern Time hours can you work?

5. Are you currently working for other clients?

6. Would you like more than 20 hours/week if your work is strong and additional hours are offered?



**Please do not apply if you have no prior legal experience.**



Keep your answers brief. Strong candidates will be contacted for the next step.

Part-Time Video Editor – Former UFC Fighter (For me, Soa Palelei)



Position: Part-Time Video Editor

Start Date: ASAP

Rate: Negotiable – AUD



About the Role: I am looking for an experienced and creative Video Editor to join my team and work with me.



The ideal candidate is someone who can take simple, raw footage and turn it into engaging, professional and high-quality videos. You should have a strong understanding of social media content, storytelling, pacing, transitions, music, sound effects and visual effects.



The work will include a variety of content, including fight videos, training videos, travel content, lifestyle videos, social media reels and other personal or promotional content.



We are looking for someone who can make ordinary footage look exceptional.



Key Responsibilities

- Edit short-form and long-form videos from raw footage provided by us.

- Create engaging social media videos for platforms such as Instagram,
, TikTok and YouTube.

- Edit fight, training, fitness, travel and lifestyle videos.

- Turn simple or basic footage into polished, engaging content.

- Add appropriate music, sound effects, transitions, captions and visual effects.

- Create strong hooks and engaging openings for social media videos.

- Maintain a consistent visual style and quality across content.

- Use AI video tools to transform images into video and create additional visual content when required.

- Use AI tools to enhance, animate or creatively repurpose existing content.

- Work with us on revisions and implement feedback quickly.

- Manage multiple video requests depending on the client's schedule and content needs.

- Ensure videos are optimised for different social media platforms and formats.

- Maintain confidentiality of all client content.



Requirements



We are looking for someone who:

- Has strong professional video editing experience.

- Has experience creating content for social media and personal brands.

- Can make simple footage look professional, exciting and engaging.

- Has a strong understanding of storytelling, pacing and visual composition.

- Is experienced with professional video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or similar.

- Has experience using AI video and creative tools.

- Social media content creation

- Sports or fitness content

Sample Video Requirement

Thread the Word is an Australian e-commerce brand, part of a small family of related brands. Our customers are celebrating the moments that matter — our content gets to be part of the best moments of people's lives. We're hiring a full-time Social Media & Influencer Coordinator to own our social presence end to end.



THE ROLE

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own and run the Thread the Word social media content calendar across Instagram,
, TikTok and Pinterest — planning, scheduling, publishing and reporting

 marketing calendar so social and
 campaigns run in sync (seasonal peaks: Mother's Day, Father's Day, Christmas)

- Report weekly on content performance, follower growth, engagement and creator campaign results



WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 2+ years running social media for a brand (e-commerce strongly preferred), with examples you can show

- Hands-on experience with influencer/UGC campaigns — you've briefed creators and turned their content into results

- Strong photo editing skills (Photoshop, Lightroom, Canva or equivalent) and video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or equivalent) — you will be tested on both

- Genuinely proficient with AI tools — you use them daily to work faster and better (e.g. ChatGPT/Claude for captions, briefs and planning; AI image/video features in Canva, CapCut or similar) and can show us how they fit into your workflow

- Excellent written English — your comment replies ARE our brand voice

- Confidence working directly with an Australian founder: proactive, organised, comfortable owning a calendar without being chased

- Reliable home office setup: fast internet with backup, capable computer



NICE TO HAVE

Experience with Meta Business Suite / a scheduling tool (Later, Planoly, Buffer, etc.), Klaviyo or similar
 platform familiarity, Pinterest growth experience, an eye for gifting/keepsake/family-lifestyle niches.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Full-time, permanent, DIRECT EMPLOYMENT through our Philippine entity — NOT an agency or BPO placement

- 13th-month pay + SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG + paid leave

- Remote (Philippines), hours aligned to Australian Eastern Time (Manila is only 2 hours behind Sydney)

- 45-hour week including approx. 5 hours on a weekend day, scheduled as part of your regular work week (e.g. Monday–Friday plus Saturday morning, Manila time; rest day Sunday)

- You'll report to the Director (Australia) and work alongside counterpart coordinators on our sister brands



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word SNAPSHOT. Then include:
